column3: ¶ <p-w s=H7225>In the beginning</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>the heavens</p-w> <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H776>Now the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>was</p-w> <p-w s=H8414>formless</p-w> <p-w s=H922>and void</p-w>, <p-w s=H2822>and darkness</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>was over</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>the surface</p-w> <p-w s=H8415>of the deep</p-w>. <p-w s=H7307>And the Spirit</p-w> <p-w s=H430>of God</p-w> <p-w s=H7363>was hovering</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>over</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>the surface</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>of the waters</p-w>.
<p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H1961>Let there be</p-w> <p-w s=H216>light</p-w>,” <p-w s=H1961>and there was</p-w> <p-w s=H216>light</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H216>the light</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>was good</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>and He</p-w> <p-w s=H914>separated</p-w> <p-w s=H216>the light</p-w> <p-w s=H996>from</p-w> <p-w s=H2822>the darkness</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> <p-w s=H216>the light</p-w> “<p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>,” <p-w s=H2822>and the darkness</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>He called</p-w> “<p-w s=H3915>night</p-w>.” <p-w s=H1961>And there was</p-w> <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>and there was</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w>— <p-w s=H259>the first</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H1961>Let there be</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>an expanse</p-w> <p-w s=H8432>between</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>the waters</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>to</p-w> <p-w s=H914>separate</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>the waters</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>from the waters</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H430>So God</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>the expanse</p-w> <p-w s=H914>and separated</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>the waters</p-w> <p-w s=H8478>beneath</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>it</p-w> <p-w s=H996>from</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>the waters</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>above</p-w>. <p-w s=H1961>And it was</p-w> <p-w s=H3651>so</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>the expanse</p-w> “<p-w s=H8064>sky</p-w>.” <p-w s=H1961>And there was</p-w> <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>and there was</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w>— <p-w s=H8145>the second</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4325>Let the waters</p-w> <p-w s=H8478>under</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>the sky</p-w> <p-w s=H6960>be gathered</p-w> <p-w s=H413>into</p-w> <p-w s=H259>one</p-w> <p-w s=H4725>place</p-w>, <p-w s=H3004>so that the dry land</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>may appear</p-w>.” <p-w s=H1961>And it was</p-w> <p-w s=H3651>so</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> <p-w s=H3004>the dry land</p-w> “<p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>,” <p-w s=H4723>and the gathering</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>of waters</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>He called</p-w> “<p-w s=H3220>seas</p-w>.” <p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>it was good</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>Then God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H776>Let the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H1876>bring forth</p-w> <p-w s=H1877>vegetation</p-w>: <p-w s=H2232>seed-bearing</p-w> <p-w s=H6212>plants</p-w> <p-w s=H6529>and fruit</p-w> <p-w s=H6086>trees</p-w>, <p-w s=H6213>each bearing</p-w> <p-w s=H6529>fruit</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>with seed</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to its kind</p-w>.” <p-w s=H1961>And it was</p-w> <p-w s=H3651>so</p-w>.

<p-w s=H776>The earth</p-w> <p-w s=H3318>produced</p-w> <p-w s=H1877>vegetation</p-w>: <p-w s=H2232>seed-bearing</p-w> <p-w s=H6212>plants</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to their kinds</p-w> <p-w s=H6086>and trees</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>bearing</p-w> <p-w s=H6529>fruit</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>with seed</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to their kinds</p-w>. <p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>it was good</p-w>.
<p-w s=H1961>And there was</p-w> <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>and there was</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w>— <p-w s=H7992>the third</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H1961>Let there be</p-w> <p-w s=H3974>lights</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>in the expanse</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>of the sky</p-w> <p-w s=H914>to distinguish</p-w> <p-w s=H996>between</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>the day</p-w> <p-w s=H996>and</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>the night</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>and let them be</p-w> <p-w s=H226>signs to mark</p-w> <p-w s=H4150>the seasons</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>and days</p-w> <p-w s=H8141>and years</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1961>And let them serve</p-w> <p-w s=H3974>as lights</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>in the expanse</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>of the sky</p-w> <p-w s=H215>to shine</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>upon</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w>.” <p-w s=H1961>And it was</p-w> <p-w s=H3651>so</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> <p-w s=H8147>two</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>great</p-w> <p-w s=H3974>lights</p-w>: <p-w s=H1419>the greater</p-w> <p-w s=H3974>light</p-w> <p-w s=H4475>to rule</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>the day</p-w> <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H6996>the lesser</p-w> <p-w s=H3974>light</p-w> <p-w s=H4475>to rule</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>the night</p-w>. <p-w s=H853>And He made</p-w> <p-w s=H3556>the stars {as well}</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>set</p-w> <p-w s=H853>these lights</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>in the expanse</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>of the sky</p-w> <p-w s=H215>to shine</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>upon</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w>,

<p-w s=H4910>to preside over</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>the day</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>and the night</p-w>, <p-w s=H914>and to separate</p-w> <p-w s=H216>the light</p-w> <p-w s=H996>from</p-w> <p-w s=H2822>the darkness</p-w>. <p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>it was good</p-w>.
<p-w s=H1961>And there was</p-w> <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>and there was</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w>— <p-w s=H7243>the fourth</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4325>Let the waters</p-w> <p-w s=H8317>teem</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>with living</p-w> <p-w s=H8318>creatures</p-w>, <p-w s=H5775>and let birds</p-w> <p-w s=H5774>fly</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>above</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>in</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>the open</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>expanse</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>of the sky</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H853>So</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>the great</p-w> <p-w s=H8577>sea creatures</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and every</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>living</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>thing</p-w> <p-w s=H7430>that moves</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>with which</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>the waters</p-w> <p-w s=H8317>teemed</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to their kinds</p-w>, <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>every</p-w> <p-w s=H3671>winged</p-w> <p-w s=H5775>bird</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>after its kind</p-w>. <p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>it was good</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>Then God</p-w> <p-w s=H1288>blessed</p-w> <p-w s=H853>them</p-w> <p-w s=H559>and said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H6509>Be fruitful</p-w> <p-w s=H7235>and multiply</p-w> <p-w s=H4390>and fill</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>the waters</p-w> <p-w s=H3220>of the seas</p-w>, <p-w s=H5775>and let birds</p-w> <p-w s=H7235>multiply</p-w> <p-w s=H776>on the earth</p-w>.”
<p-w s=H1961>And there was</p-w> <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>and there was</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w>— <p-w s=H2549>the fifth</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H776>Let the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H3318>bring forth</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>living</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>creatures</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to their kinds</p-w>: <p-w s=H929>livestock</p-w>, <p-w s=H7431>land crawlers</p-w>, <p-w s=H2416>and beasts</p-w> <p-w s=H776>of the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to their kinds</p-w>.” <p-w s=H1961>And it was</p-w> <p-w s=H3651>so</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>the beasts</p-w> <p-w s=H776>of the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to their kinds</p-w>, <p-w s=H929>the livestock</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to their kinds</p-w>, <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>everything</p-w> <p-w s=H7431>that crawls</p-w> <p-w s=H127>upon the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H4327>according to its kind</p-w>. <p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>it was good</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>Then God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H6213>Let Us make</p-w> <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> <p-w s=H6754>in Our image</p-w>, <p-w s=H1823>after Our likeness</p-w>, <p-w s=H7287>to rule</p-w> <p-w s=H1710>over the fish</p-w> <p-w s=H3220>of the sea</p-w> <p-w s=H5775>and the birds</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>of the air</p-w>, <p-w s=H929>over the livestock</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>and over all</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth itself</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and every</p-w> <p-w s=H7431>creature</p-w> <p-w s=H7430>that crawls</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>upon</p-w> <p-w s=H776>it</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H430>So God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> <p-w s=H6754>in His own image</p-w>; <p-w s=H6754>in the image</p-w> <p-w s=H430>of God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>He created</p-w> <p-w s=H853>him</p-w>; <p-w s=H2145>male</p-w> <p-w s=H5347>and female</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>He created</p-w> <p-w s=H853>them</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1288>blessed</p-w> <p-w s=H853>them</p-w> <p-w s=H430>and</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> to them, “<p-w s=H6509>Be fruitful</p-w> <p-w s=H7235>and multiply</p-w>, <p-w s=H4390>and fill</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H3533>and subdue it</p-w>; <p-w s=H7287>rule</p-w> <p-w s=H1710>over the fish</p-w> <p-w s=H3220>of the sea</p-w> <p-w s=H5775>and the birds</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>of the air</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and every</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>creature</p-w> <p-w s=H7430>that crawls</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>upon</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H430>Then God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H2009>Behold</p-w>, <p-w s=H5414>I have given</p-w> you <p-w s=H3605>every</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>seed-bearing</p-w> <p-w s=H6212>plant</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>the face</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>of all</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w>, <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>every</p-w> <p-w s=H6086>tree</p-w> <p-w s=H834>whose</p-w> <p-w s=H6529>fruit</p-w> <p-w s=H2232>contains</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>seed</p-w>. <p-w s=H1961>They will be</p-w> yours <p-w s=H402>for food</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3605>And to every</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>beast</p-w> <p-w s=H776>of the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and every</p-w> <p-w s=H5775>bird</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>of the air</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and every</p-w> <p-w s=H7430>creature that crawls</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>upon</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w>— <p-w s=H834>everything that has</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>the breath</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>of life</p-w> in it— <p-w s=H3605>I have given every</p-w> <p-w s=H3418>green</p-w> <p-w s=H6212>plant</p-w> <p-w s=H402>for food</p-w>.” <p-w s=H1961>And it was</p-w> <p-w s=H3651>so</p-w>.

<p-w s=H430>And God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>looked upon</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>He had made</p-w>, <p-w s=H2009>and indeed</p-w>, <p-w s=H3966>it was very</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>. <p-w s=H1961>And there was</p-w> <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>and there was</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w>— <p-w s=H8345>the sixth</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.
¶ <p-w s=H8064>Thus the heavens</p-w> <p-w s=H776>and the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H3615>were completed</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>in all</p-w> <p-w s=H6635>their vast array</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7637>And by the seventh</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H3615>had finished</p-w> <p-w s=H4399>the work</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>He had been doing</p-w>; <p-w s=H7637>so on that</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> <p-w s=H7673>He rested</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>from all</p-w> <p-w s=H4399>His work</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H430>Then God</p-w> <p-w s=H1288>blessed</p-w> <p-w s=H7637>the seventh</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> <p-w s=H6942>and sanctified</p-w> <p-w s=H853>it</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>because</p-w> on that day <p-w s=H7673>He rested</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>from all</p-w> <p-w s=H4399>the work</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>of creation</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H430>He</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>had accomplished</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H428>This</p-w> <p-w s=H8435>is the account</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>of the heavens</p-w> <p-w s=H776>and the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>when they were created</p-w>, <p-w s=H3117>in the day</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>that the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> <p-w s=H776>them</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1931>That</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H3467>saved</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>from the hand</p-w> <p-w s=H4714>of the Egyptians</p-w>, <p-w s=H3478>and Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> <p-w s=H4714>the Egyptians</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>dead</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H8193>the shore</p-w>.

<p-w s=H853>But</p-w> <p-w s=H2219>I will scatter</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>you among the nations</p-w> <p-w s=H7324>and will draw out</p-w> <p-w s=H2719>a sword</p-w> <p-w s=H310>after you</p-w> <p-w s=H776>as your land</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>becomes</p-w> <p-w s=H8077>desolate</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>and your cities</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>are laid</p-w> <p-w s=H2723>waste</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H227>Then</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w> <p-w s=H7521>shall enjoy</p-w> <p-w s=H853>its</p-w> <p-w s=H7676>Sabbaths</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>the days</p-w> <p-w s=H8074>it lies desolate</p-w>, <p-w s=H859>while you</p-w> <p-w s=H776>are in the land</p-w> <p-w s=H341>of your enemies</p-w>. <p-w s=H227>At that time</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w> <p-w s=H7673>will rest</p-w> <p-w s=H7521>and enjoy</p-w> <p-w s=H853>its</p-w> <p-w s=H7676>Sabbaths</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3605>As long as</p-w> <p-w s=H8074>it lies desolate</p-w>, <p-w s=H7673>the land will have the rest</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>it did not</p-w> <p-w s=H7673>receive</p-w> <p-w s=H7676>during the Sabbaths</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>when you lived</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>in it</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H7604>As for those of you who survive</p-w>, <p-w s=H935>I will send</p-w> <p-w s=H4816>a faintness</p-w> <p-w s=H3824>into their hearts</p-w> <p-w s=H776>in the lands</p-w> <p-w s=H341>of their enemies</p-w>, <p-w s=H6963>so that even the sound</p-w> <p-w s=H5086>of a windblown</p-w> <p-w s=H5929>leaf</p-w> <p-w s=H7291>will put them to flight</p-w>. <p-w s=H5127>And they will flee</p-w> <p-w s=H4499>as one flees</p-w> <p-w s=H2719>the sword</p-w>, <p-w s=H5307>and fall</p-w> <p-w s=H369>when no one</p-w> <p-w s=H7291>pursues them</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3782>They will stumble</p-w> <p-w s=H376>over one</p-w> <p-w s=H251>another</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>as before</p-w> <p-w s=H2719>the sword</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>though no one</p-w> <p-w s=H7291>is behind them</p-w>. <p-w s=H3808>So</p-w> you will not <p-w s=H1961>be</p-w> <p-w s=H8617>able to stand</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>against</p-w> <p-w s=H341>your enemies</p-w>.
¶ <p-w s=H6>You will perish</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>among the nations</p-w>, <p-w s=H776>and the land</p-w> <p-w s=H341>of your enemies</p-w> <p-w s=H398>will consume</p-w> <p-w s=H853>you</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7604>Those of you who survive</p-w> <p-w s=H776>in the lands</p-w> <p-w s=H341>of your enemies</p-w> <p-w s=H4743>will waste away</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>in their iniquity</p-w> <p-w s=H637>and</p-w> <p-w s=H4743>will decay</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>in the sins</p-w> <p-w s=H1>of their fathers</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3034>But if they will confess</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>their iniquity</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>and that</p-w> <p-w s=H1>of their fathers</p-w> <p-w s=H4604>in the unfaithfulness</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H4603>they practiced</p-w> against Me, <p-w s=H834>by which</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>they have also walked</p-w> <p-w s=H7147>in hostility</p-w> <p-w s=H5973>toward Me</p-w>—

<p-w s=H637>and</p-w> <p-w s=H589>I</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>acted</p-w> <p-w s=H7147>with hostility</p-w> <p-w s=H5973>toward them</p-w> <p-w s=H935>and brought</p-w> <p-w s=H853>them</p-w> <p-w s=H776>into the land</p-w> <p-w s=H341>of their enemies</p-w>— <p-w s=H176>and</p-w> <p-w s=H6189>if their uncircumcised</p-w> <p-w s=H3824>hearts</p-w> <p-w s=H3665>will be humbled</p-w> <p-w s=H7521>and they will make amends</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>for their iniquity</p-w>,

<p-w s=H2142>then I will remember</p-w> <p-w s=H1285>My covenant</p-w> <p-w s=H3290>with Jacob</p-w> <p-w s=H637>and</p-w> <p-w s=H1285>My covenant</p-w> <p-w s=H3327>with Isaac</p-w> <p-w s=H1285>and My covenant</p-w> <p-w s=H85>with Abraham</p-w>, <p-w s=H2142>and I will remember</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H776>For the land</p-w> <p-w s=H5800>will be abandoned</p-w> by them, <p-w s=H7521>and it will enjoy</p-w> <p-w s=H7676>its Sabbaths</p-w> <p-w s=H8074>by lying desolate</p-w> without them. <p-w s=H1992>And they</p-w> <p-w s=H7521>will pay the penalty</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>for their iniquity</p-w>, <p-w s=H3282>because</p-w> <p-w s=H3988>they rejected</p-w> <p-w s=H4941>My ordinances</p-w> <p-w s=H1602>and abhorred</p-w> <p-w s=H2708>My statutes</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H637>Yet</p-w> <p-w s=H1571>in spite of</p-w> <p-w s=H2063>this</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>when they are</p-w> <p-w s=H776>in the land</p-w> <p-w s=H341>of their enemies</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>I will not</p-w> <p-w s=H3988>reject</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>or</p-w> <p-w s=H1602>despise them</p-w> <p-w s=H3615>so as to destroy them</p-w> <p-w s=H6565>and break</p-w> <p-w s=H1285>My covenant</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with them</p-w>; <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H589>I</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>am the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H430>their God</p-w>.

But for their sake <p-w s=H2142>I will remember</p-w> <p-w s=H1285>the covenant</p-w> <p-w s=H7223>with their fathers</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>whom</p-w> <p-w s=H3318>I brought out</p-w> <p-w s=H776>of the land</p-w> <p-w s=H4714>of Egypt</p-w> <p-w s=H5869>in the sight</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>of the nations</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>that I might be</p-w> their <p-w s=H430>God</p-w>. <p-w s=H589>I</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>am the LORD</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H428>These</p-w> <p-w s=H2706>are the statutes</p-w>, <p-w s=H4941>ordinances</p-w>, <p-w s=H8451>and laws</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>established</p-w> <p-w s=H996>between Himself</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>and the Israelites</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>through</p-w> <p-w s=H4872>Moses</p-w> <p-w s=H2022>on Mount</p-w> <p-w s=H5514>Sinai</p-w>.
¶ <p-w s=H3068>Then the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H4872>Moses</p-w>,

“<p-w s=H1696>Speak</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>the Israelites</p-w> <p-w s=H559>and say</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to them</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H3588>When</p-w> <p-w s=H376>someone</p-w> <p-w s=H6381>makes a special</p-w> <p-w s=H5088>vow</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>to the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6187>involving the value</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>of persons</p-w>,

<p-w s=H6187>if the valuation</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>concerns</p-w> <p-w s=H2145>a male</p-w> <p-w s=H6242>from twenty</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>to</p-w> <p-w s=H8346>sixty</p-w> <p-w s=H8141>years of age</p-w>, <p-w s=H6187>then your valuation</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>shall be</p-w> <p-w s=H2572>fifty</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>of silver</p-w>, <p-w s=H6944>according to the sanctuary</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekel</p-w>.
<p-w s=H518>Or if</p-w> <p-w s=H1931>it</p-w> <p-w s=H5347>is a female</p-w>, <p-w s=H6187>then your valuation</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>shall be</p-w> <p-w s=H7970>thirty</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w>.

<p-w s=H518>And if the person is</p-w> <p-w s=H2568>from five</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>to</p-w> <p-w s=H6242>twenty</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>years of age</p-w>, <p-w s=H6187>then your valuation</p-w> <p-w s=H2145>for the male</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>shall be</p-w> <p-w s=H6242>twenty</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w>, <p-w s=H5347>and for the female</p-w> <p-w s=H6235>ten</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H518>Now if the person is</p-w> <p-w s=H2320>from one month</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>to</p-w> <p-w s=H2568>five</p-w> <p-w s=H8141>years of age</p-w>, <p-w s=H6187>then your valuation</p-w> <p-w s=H2145>for the male</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>shall be</p-w> <p-w s=H2568>five</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>of silver</p-w>, <p-w s=H5347>and for the female</p-w> <p-w s=H7969>three</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>of silver</p-w>.

<p-w s=H518>And if the person is</p-w> <p-w s=H8346>sixty</p-w> <p-w s=H8141>years of age</p-w> <p-w s=H4605>or older</p-w>, <p-w s=H6187>then your valuation</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>shall be</p-w> <p-w s=H2568>fifteen</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w> <p-w s=H2145>for the male</p-w> <p-w s=H6235>and ten</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w> <p-w s=H5347>for the female</p-w>.

<p-w s=H518>But if</p-w> <p-w s=H1931>the one making the vow</p-w> <p-w s=H4134>is too poor to pay</p-w> <p-w s=H6187>the valuation</p-w>, <p-w s=H5975>he is to present the person</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> <p-w s=H3548>the priest</p-w>, <p-w s=H3548>who</p-w> <p-w s=H6186>shall set the value</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>according to</p-w> <p-w s=H834>what</p-w> <p-w s=H5087>the one making the vow</p-w> <p-w s=H5381>can afford</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H518>If he vows</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>an</p-w> <p-w s=H929>animal</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H7126>may be brought</p-w> <p-w s=H7133>as an offering</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>to the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>any</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>such animal</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>given</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>to the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>shall be</p-w> <p-w s=H6944>holy</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3808>He must not</p-w> <p-w s=H2498>replace it</p-w> <p-w s=H4171>or exchange it</p-w>, <p-w s=H2896>either good</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>for bad</p-w> <p-w s=H176>or</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>bad</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>for good</p-w>. <p-w s=H518>But if</p-w> <p-w s=H4171>he does substitute</p-w> <p-w s=H929>one animal</p-w> <p-w s=H929>for another</p-w>, <p-w s=H1931>both that animal</p-w> <p-w s=H8545>and its substitute</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>will be</p-w> <p-w s=H6944>holy</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H518>But if</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>the vow involves any</p-w> <p-w s=H2931>of the unclean</p-w> <p-w s=H929>animals</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>may not</p-w> <p-w s=H7126>be brought</p-w> <p-w s=H7133>as an offering</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>to the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H929>the animal</p-w> <p-w s=H5975>must be presented</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> <p-w s=H3548>the priest</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3548>The priest</p-w> <p-w s=H6186>shall set its value</p-w>, <p-w s=H2896>whether high</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>or low</p-w>; <p-w s=H3548>as the priest</p-w> <p-w s=H6187>values it</p-w>, <p-w s=H3651>the price</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>will be set</p-w>.
<p-w s=H518>If, however, the owner</p-w> <p-w s=H1350>decides to redeem the animal</p-w>, <p-w s=H3254>he must add</p-w> <p-w s=H2549>a fifth</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>to</p-w> <p-w s=H6187>its value</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3588>Now if</p-w> <p-w s=H376>a man</p-w> <p-w s=H6942>consecrates</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>his house</p-w> <p-w s=H6944>as holy</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>to the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H3548>then the priest</p-w> <p-w s=H6186>shall value it</p-w> <p-w s=H996>either as</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w> <p-w s=H996>or</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>bad</p-w>. <p-w s=H6965>The price will stand</p-w> <p-w s=H834>just as</p-w> <p-w s=H3548>the priest</p-w> <p-w s=H6186>values</p-w> <p-w s=H853>it</p-w>.

<p-w s=H518>But if</p-w> <p-w s=H6942>he who consecrated</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>his house</p-w> <p-w s=H1350>redeems</p-w> <p-w s=H853>it</p-w>, <p-w s=H3254>he must add</p-w> <p-w s=H2549>a fifth</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>to</p-w> <p-w s=H6187>the assessed</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>value</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>and it will belong</p-w> to him.

¶ <p-w s=H518>If</p-w> <p-w s=H376>a man</p-w> <p-w s=H6942>consecrates</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>to the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H7704>a parcel</p-w> <p-w s=H272>of his land</p-w>, <p-w s=H6187>then your valuation</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>shall be</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>proportional</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>to the seed required for it</p-w>— <p-w s=H2572>fifty</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>shekels</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>of silver</p-w> <p-w s=H2563>for every homer</p-w> <p-w s=H8184>of barley</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>seed</p-w>.

<p-w s=H518>If</p-w> <p-w s=H6942>he consecrates</p-w> <p-w s=H7704>his field</p-w> <p-w s=H8141>during the Year</p-w> <p-w s=H3104>of Jubilee</p-w>, <p-w s=H6965>the price will stand</p-w> <p-w s=H6187>according to your valuation</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H518>But if</p-w> <p-w s=H6942>he consecrates</p-w> <p-w s=H7704>his field</p-w> <p-w s=H310>after</p-w> <p-w s=H3104>the Jubilee</p-w>, <p-w s=H3548>the priest</p-w> <p-w s=H2803>is to calculate</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>the price</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>in proportion to</p-w> <p-w s=H8141>the years</p-w> <p-w s=H3498>left</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>until</p-w> <p-w s=H8141>the next Year</p-w> <p-w s=H3104>of Jubilee</p-w>, <p-w s=H6187>so that your valuation</p-w> <p-w s=H1639>will be reduced</p-w>.

<p-w s=H518>And if</p-w> <p-w s=H6942>the one who consecrated</p-w> <p-w s=H7704>the field</p-w> <p-w s=H1350>decides to redeem it</p-w>, <p-w s=H3254>he must add</p-w> <p-w s=H2549>a fifth</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>to</p-w> <p-w s=H6187>the assessed</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>value</p-w>, <p-w s=H6965>and it shall belong</p-w> to him.

¶ <p-w s=H3091>Then Joshua</p-w> <p-w s=H7167>tore</p-w> <p-w s=H8071>his clothes</p-w> <p-w s=H5307>and fell</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>facedown</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> <p-w s=H727>the ark</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>until</p-w> <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w>, <p-w s=H2205>as did the elders</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>; <p-w s=H5927>and they all sprinkled</p-w> <p-w s=H6083>dust</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H7218>their heads</p-w>.

¶ “<p-w s=H162>O</p-w>, <p-w s=H136>Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3069>GOD</p-w>,” <p-w s=H3091>Joshua</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4100>why</p-w> <p-w s=H5674>did You ever bring</p-w> <p-w s=H2088>this</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w> <p-w s=H3383>across the Jordan</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>to deliver</p-w> <p-w s=H853>us</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>into the hand</p-w> <p-w s=H567>of the Amorites</p-w> <p-w s=H6>to be destroyed</p-w>? <p-w s=H3863>If only</p-w> <p-w s=H2974>we had been content</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>to stay</p-w> <p-w s=H5676>on the other side</p-w> <p-w s=H3383>of the Jordan</p-w>!

<p-w s=H3669>When the Canaanites</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>who live</p-w> <p-w s=H776>in the land</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>hear about this</p-w>, <p-w s=H5437>they will surround</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>us</p-w> <p-w s=H3772>and wipe out</p-w> <p-w s=H8034>our name</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>from</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w>. <p-w s=H4100>Then what</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>will You do</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>for Your great</p-w> <p-w s=H8034>name</p-w>?”

¶ <p-w s=H3068>But the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3091>Joshua</p-w>, “<p-w s=H6965>Stand up</p-w>! <p-w s=H4100>Why</p-w> <p-w s=H859>have you</p-w> <p-w s=H5307>fallen</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>your face</p-w>?

<p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H2398>has sinned</p-w>; <p-w s=H5674>they have transgressed</p-w> <p-w s=H1285>My covenant</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H6680>I commanded</p-w> <p-w s=H853>them</p-w>, <p-w s=H1571>and they</p-w> <p-w s=H3947>have taken</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>some of</p-w> <p-w s=H2764>what was devoted to destruction</p-w>. <p-w s=H1571>Indeed</p-w>, <p-w s=H1589>they have stolen</p-w> <p-w s=H1571>and</p-w> <p-w s=H3584>lied</p-w>, <p-w s=H1571>and</p-w> <p-w s=H7760>they have put these things</p-w> <p-w s=H3627>with their own possessions</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1121>This is why the Israelites</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>cannot</p-w> <p-w s=H6965>stand</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>against</p-w> <p-w s=H341>their enemies</p-w>. <p-w s=H6437>They will turn</p-w> <p-w s=H6203>their backs</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>and run from</p-w> <p-w s=H341>their enemies</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>because</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>they themselves have been</p-w> <p-w s=H2764>set apart for destruction</p-w>. <p-w s=H3808>I will no</p-w> <p-w s=H3254>longer</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>be</p-w> <p-w s=H5973>with</p-w> <p-w s=H518>you unless</p-w> <p-w s=H8045>you remove</p-w> <p-w s=H7130>from among you</p-w> <p-w s=H2764>whatever is devoted to destruction</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H6965>Get up</p-w> <p-w s=H6942>and consecrate</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>the people</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H6942>Consecrate yourselves</p-w> <p-w s=H4279>for tomorrow</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H3541>this is what</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>the God</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: <p-w s=H7130>Among you</p-w>, <p-w s=H3478>O Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H2764>there are things devoted to destruction</p-w>. <p-w s=H3808>You cannot</p-w> <p-w s=H6965>stand</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>against</p-w> <p-w s=H341>your enemies</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>until</p-w> <p-w s=H5493>you remove</p-w> <p-w s=H2764>them</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1242>In the morning</p-w> <p-w s=H7126>you must present yourselves</p-w> <p-w s=H7626>tribe by tribe</p-w>. <p-w s=H7626>The tribe</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H3920>selects</p-w> <p-w s=H7126>shall come forward</p-w> <p-w s=H4940>clan by clan</p-w>, <p-w s=H4940>and the clan</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H3920>selects</p-w> <p-w s=H7126>shall come forward</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>family by family</p-w>, <p-w s=H1004>and the family</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H3920>selects</p-w> <p-w s=H7126>shall come forward</p-w> <p-w s=H1397>man by man</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3920>The one who is caught</p-w> <p-w s=H2764>with the things devoted to destruction</p-w> <p-w s=H8313>must be burned</p-w>, <p-w s=H853>along with all</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>that belongs to him</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>because</p-w> <p-w s=H5674>he has transgressed</p-w> <p-w s=H1285>the covenant</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>and</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>committed</p-w> <p-w s=H5039>an outrage</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>in Israel</p-w>.’”

¶ <p-w s=H3091>So Joshua</p-w> <p-w s=H7925>arose early</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>the next morning</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>and had Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H7126>come forward</p-w> <p-w s=H7626>tribe by tribe</p-w>, <p-w s=H7626>and the tribe</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H3920>was selected</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1004>And he had the family of Zabdi</p-w> <p-w s=H7126>come forward</p-w> <p-w s=H1397>man by man</p-w>, <p-w s=H5912>and Achan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H3756>of Carmi</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>the son</p-w> <p-w s=H2067>of Zabdi</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>the son</p-w> <p-w s=H2226>of Zerah</p-w>, <p-w s=H4294>of the tribe</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w>, <p-w s=H3920>was selected</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3091>So Joshua</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H5912>Achan</p-w>, “<p-w s=H1121>My son</p-w>, <p-w s=H7760>give</p-w> <p-w s=H3519>glory</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>to the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>the God</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H5414>and make</p-w> <p-w s=H8426>a confession</p-w> to Him. <p-w s=H4994>I urge you</p-w> <p-w s=H5046>to tell</p-w> me <p-w s=H4100>what</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>you have done</p-w>; <p-w s=H408>do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3582>hide it</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>from me</p-w>.”

¶ “<p-w s=H546>It is true</p-w>,” <p-w s=H5912>Achan</p-w> <p-w s=H6030>replied</p-w>, “<p-w s=H595>I</p-w> <p-w s=H2398>have sinned</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>against the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>the God</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>. <p-w s=H2063>This</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>is what I did</p-w>:

¶ <p-w s=H3091>Then Joshua</p-w>, <p-w s=H5973>together with</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H3947>took</p-w> <p-w s=H5912>Achan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H2226>of Zerah</p-w>, <p-w s=H3701>the silver</p-w>, <p-w s=H155>the cloak</p-w>, <p-w s=H3956>the bar</p-w> <p-w s=H2091>of gold</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>his sons</p-w> <p-w s=H1323>and daughters</p-w>, <p-w s=H7794>his oxen</p-w> <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H2543>donkeys</p-w> <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H6629>sheep</p-w>, <p-w s=H168>his tent</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>and everything else</p-w> <p-w s=H834>he owned</p-w>, <p-w s=H5927>and brought them</p-w> <p-w s=H6010>to the Valley</p-w> <p-w s=H5911>of Achor</p-w>.

¶ “<p-w s=H4100>Why</p-w> <p-w s=H5916>have you brought this trouble upon us</p-w>?” <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> <p-w s=H3091>Joshua</p-w>. “<p-w s=H3117>Today</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H5916>will bring trouble upon you</p-w>!” <p-w s=H3605>And all</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H7275>stoned him to death</p-w>. <p-w s=H5619>Then they stoned the others</p-w> <p-w s=H8313>and burned their bodies</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6965>And they heaped</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>over Achan</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>a large</p-w> <p-w s=H1530>pile</p-w> <p-w s=H68>of rocks</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>that remains to</p-w> <p-w s=H2088>this</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>. <p-w s=H3068>So the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>turned</p-w> <p-w s=H2740>from His burning anger</p-w>. <p-w s=H5921>Therefore</p-w> <p-w s=H1931>that</p-w> <p-w s=H4725>place</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>is called</p-w> <p-w s=H6010>the Valley</p-w> <p-w s=H5911>of Achor</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>to</p-w> <p-w s=H2088>this</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H1931>Then Naaman</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>his attendants</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>went back</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H376>the man</p-w> <p-w s=H430>of God</p-w>, <p-w s=H5975>stood</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before him</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>and declared</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4994>Now</p-w> <p-w s=H3045>I know</p-w> <p-w s=H2009>for sure</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H369>there is no</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>in all</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>except</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>in Israel</p-w>. <p-w s=H6258>So</p-w> <p-w s=H4994>please</p-w> <p-w s=H3947>accept</p-w> <p-w s=H1293>a gift</p-w> <p-w s=H854>from</p-w> <p-w s=H5650>your servant</p-w>.”

¶ “<p-w s=H1980>Go</p-w> <p-w s=H7965>in peace</p-w>,” <p-w s=H559>said Elisha</p-w>. <p-w s=H1980>But after Naaman had traveled</p-w> <p-w s=H3530>a short distance</p-w>,

¶ <p-w s=H477>Now Elisha</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>was sitting</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>in his house</p-w>, <p-w s=H2205>and the elders</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>were sitting</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with him</p-w>. <p-w s=H7971>The king sent</p-w> <p-w s=H376>a messenger</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>ahead</p-w>, <p-w s=H2962>but before</p-w> <p-w s=H4397>he</p-w> <p-w s=H935>arrived</p-w>, <p-w s=H1931>Elisha</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H2205>the elders</p-w>, “<p-w s=H7200>Do you see</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>how</p-w> <p-w s=H2088>this</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>murderer</p-w> <p-w s=H7971>has sent</p-w> <p-w s=H5493>someone to cut off</p-w> <p-w s=H7218>my head</p-w>? <p-w s=H7200>Look</p-w>, <p-w s=H4397>when the messenger</p-w> <p-w s=H935>comes</p-w>, <p-w s=H5462>shut</p-w> <p-w s=H1817>the door</p-w> <p-w s=H3905>to keep him out</p-w>. <p-w s=H3808>Is not</p-w> <p-w s=H6963>the sound</p-w> <p-w s=H113>of his master’s</p-w> <p-w s=H7272>footsteps</p-w> <p-w s=H310>behind him</p-w>?”

¶ <p-w s=H5750>While Elisha was still</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>speaking</p-w> <p-w s=H5973>with them</p-w>, <p-w s=H4397>the messenger</p-w> <p-w s=H3381>came down</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to him</p-w>. <p-w s=H559>And the king said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H2063>This</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>calamity is</p-w> <p-w s=H854>from</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w>. <p-w s=H4100>Why</p-w> <p-w s=H3176>should I wait</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>for the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H5750>any longer</p-w>?”

¶ <p-w s=H477>Then Elisha</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H8085>Hear</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>the word</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w>! <p-w s=H3541>This is what</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: ‘<p-w s=H6256>About this time</p-w> <p-w s=H4279>tomorrow</p-w> <p-w s=H8179>at the gate</p-w> <p-w s=H8111>of Samaria</p-w>, <p-w s=H5429>a seah</p-w> <p-w s=H5560>of fine flour</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>will sell for a shekel</p-w>, <p-w s=H5429>and two seahs</p-w> <p-w s=H8184>of barley</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>will sell for a shekel</p-w>.’”

¶ <p-w s=H7991>But the officer</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>whose arm</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H8172>leaned</p-w> <p-w s=H6030>answered</p-w> <p-w s=H376>the man</p-w> <p-w s=H430>of God</p-w>, “<p-w s=H2009>Look</p-w>, <p-w s=H3068>even if the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>were to make</p-w> <p-w s=H699>windows</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>in heaven</p-w>, <p-w s=H2088>could this</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>really happen</p-w>?” “<p-w s=H7200>You will see it</p-w> <p-w s=H5869>with your own eyes</p-w>,” <p-w s=H559>replied Elisha</p-w>, <p-w s=H398>but you will not eat</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>any of it</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H1961>Now there were</p-w> <p-w s=H702>four</p-w> <p-w s=H582>men</p-w> <p-w s=H6879>with leprosy</p-w> <p-w s=H6607>at the entrance</p-w> <p-w s=H8179>of the city gate</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>and they said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H376>one</p-w> <p-w s=H7453>another</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4100>Why</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>just sit</p-w> <p-w s=H6311>here</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>until</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>we die</p-w>?

<p-w s=H518>If</p-w> <p-w s=H559>we say</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H935>Let us go into</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>the city</p-w>,’ <p-w s=H4191>we will die</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>there</p-w> <p-w s=H7458>from the famine</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>in the city</p-w>; <p-w s=H518>but if</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>we sit</p-w> <p-w s=H6311>here</p-w>, <p-w s=H4191>we will also die</p-w>. <p-w s=H1980>So come</p-w> <p-w s=H6258>now</p-w>, <p-w s=H5307>let us go over</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>the camp</p-w> <p-w s=H758>of the Arameans</p-w>. <p-w s=H518>If</p-w> <p-w s=H2421>they let us live</p-w>, <p-w s=H2421>we will live</p-w>; <p-w s=H518>if</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>they kill us</p-w>, <p-w s=H4191>we will die</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H6965>So they arose</p-w> <p-w s=H5399>at twilight</p-w> <p-w s=H935>and went</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>the camp</p-w> <p-w s=H758>of the Arameans</p-w>. <p-w s=H935>But when they came</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>to</p-w> <p-w s=H7097>the outskirts</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>of the camp</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>there was not</p-w> <p-w s=H376>a man</p-w> <p-w s=H2009>to be found</p-w>.

<p-w s=H136>For the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H758>{had caused} the Arameans</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>to hear</p-w> <p-w s=H6963>the sound</p-w> <p-w s=H7393>of chariots</p-w>, <p-w s=H5483>horses</p-w>, <p-w s=H1419>and a great</p-w> <p-w s=H2428>army</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>so that they said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H376>one</p-w> <p-w s=H251>another</p-w>, “<p-w s=H2009>Look</p-w>, <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H7936>must have hired</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the kings</p-w> <p-w s=H2850>of the Hittites</p-w> <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H4714>Egyptians</p-w> <p-w s=H935>to attack</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>us</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H6965>Thus the Arameans had arisen</p-w> <p-w s=H5127>and fled</p-w> <p-w s=H5399>at twilight</p-w>, <p-w s=H5800>abandoning</p-w> <p-w s=H168>their tents</p-w> <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H5483>horses</p-w> <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> <p-w s=H2543>donkeys</p-w>. <p-w s=H4264>The camp was intact</p-w>, <p-w s=H5127>and they had run</p-w> <p-w s=H413>for</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>their lives</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H428>When the</p-w> <p-w s=H6879>lepers</p-w> <p-w s=H935>reached</p-w> <p-w s=H7097>the edge</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>of the camp</p-w>, <p-w s=H935>they went</p-w> <p-w s=H413>into</p-w> <p-w s=H259>a</p-w> <p-w s=H168>tent</p-w> <p-w s=H398>to eat</p-w> <p-w s=H8354>and drink</p-w>. <p-w s=H5375>Then they carried off</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>the silver</p-w>, <p-w s=H2091>gold</p-w>, <p-w s=H899>and clothing</p-w>, <p-w s=H1980>and went</p-w> <p-w s=H2934>and hid them</p-w>. <p-w s=H7725>On returning</p-w>, <p-w s=H935>they entered</p-w> <p-w s=H312>another</p-w> <p-w s=H168>tent</p-w>, <p-w s=H5375>carried off some items</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>from there</p-w>, <p-w s=H2934>and hid them</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H559>Finally, they said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H376>one</p-w> <p-w s=H7453>another</p-w>, “<p-w s=H587>We are</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>not</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>doing</p-w> <p-w s=H3651>what is right</p-w>. <p-w s=H3117>Today</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>is a day</p-w> <p-w s=H1309>of good news</p-w>. <p-w s=H587>If we</p-w> <p-w s=H2814>are silent</p-w> <p-w s=H2442>and wait</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>until</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w> <p-w s=H216>light</p-w>, <p-w s=H5771>our sin</p-w> <p-w s=H4672>will overtake us</p-w>. <p-w s=H6258>Now, therefore</p-w>, <p-w s=H935>let us go</p-w> <p-w s=H5046>and tell</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king’s</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>household</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H935>So they went</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>and called out</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H7778>the gatekeepers</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>of the city</p-w>, <p-w s=H5046>saying</p-w>, “<p-w s=H935>We went</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H758>the Aramean</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>camp</p-w> <p-w s=H369>and no</p-w> <p-w s=H376>one was</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>there</p-w>— <p-w s=H6963>not a trace</p-w>— <p-w s=H518>only</p-w> <p-w s=H631>tethered</p-w> <p-w s=H5483>horses</p-w> <p-w s=H2543>and donkeys</p-w>, <p-w s=H168>and the tents</p-w> <p-w s=H1992>were intact</p-w>.”
¶ <p-w s=H7778>The gatekeepers</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>shouted the news</p-w>, <p-w s=H5046>and it was reported</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>to the king’s</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>household</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H4428>So the king</p-w> <p-w s=H6965>got up</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>in the night</p-w> <p-w s=H559>and said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H5650>his servants</p-w>, “<p-w s=H5046>Let me tell</p-w> you <p-w s=H834>what</p-w> <p-w s=H758>the Arameans</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>have done</p-w> to us. <p-w s=H3045>They know</p-w> <p-w s=H587>we</p-w> <p-w s=H7457>are starving</p-w>, <p-w s=H3318>so they have left</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>the camp</p-w> <p-w s=H2247>to hide</p-w> <p-w s=H7704>in the field</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>thinking</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H3588>When</p-w> <p-w s=H3318>they come out</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>of</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>the city</p-w>, <p-w s=H8610>we will take them</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>alive</p-w> <p-w s=H935>and enter</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>the city</p-w>.’”

¶ <p-w s=H259>But one</p-w> <p-w s=H5650>of his servants</p-w> <p-w s=H6030>replied</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4994>Please</p-w>, <p-w s=H3947>have scouts take</p-w> <p-w s=H2568>five</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>of</p-w> <p-w s=H5483>the horses</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H7604>remain</p-w> in the city. <p-w s=H2009>Their plight</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>will be no worse than all</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>the Israelites</p-w> <p-w s=H834>who</p-w> <p-w s=H7604>are left</p-w> here. <p-w s=H2005>You can see</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>that</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>all the Israelites</p-w> <p-w s=H834>here</p-w> <p-w s=H8552>are doomed</p-w>. <p-w s=H7971>So let us send them</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>and find out</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H3947>Then the scouts took</p-w> <p-w s=H8147>two</p-w> <p-w s=H7393>chariots</p-w> <p-w s=H5483>with horses</p-w>, <p-w s=H4428>and the king</p-w> <p-w s=H7971>sent them</p-w> <p-w s=H310>after</p-w> <p-w s=H758>the Aramean</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>army</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>, “<p-w s=H1980>Go</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>and see</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H1980>And they tracked them</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>as</p-w> <p-w s=H3383>far as the Jordan</p-w>, <p-w s=H2009>and indeed</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>the whole</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>way</p-w> <p-w s=H4392>was littered with</p-w> <p-w s=H899>the clothing</p-w> <p-w s=H3627>and equipment</p-w> <p-w s=H758>the Arameans</p-w> <p-w s=H7993>had thrown off</p-w> <p-w s=H2648>in haste</p-w>. <p-w s=H4397>So the scouts</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>returned</p-w> <p-w s=H5046>and told</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H5971>Then the people</p-w> <p-w s=H3318>went out</p-w> <p-w s=H962>and plundered</p-w> <p-w s=H4264>the camp</p-w> <p-w s=H758>of the Arameans</p-w>. <p-w s=H1961>It was then that</p-w> <p-w s=H5429>a seah</p-w> <p-w s=H5560>of fine flour</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>sold for a shekel</p-w>, <p-w s=H5429>and two seahs</p-w> <p-w s=H8184>of barley</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>sold for a shekel</p-w>, <p-w s=H1697>according to the word</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H4428>Now the king</p-w> <p-w s=H6485>had appointed</p-w> <p-w s=H7991>the officer</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H834>whose</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>arm</p-w> <p-w s=H8172>he leaned</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>to be in charge of</p-w> <p-w s=H8179>the gate</p-w>, <p-w s=H5971>but the people</p-w> <p-w s=H7429>trampled him</p-w> <p-w s=H8179>in the gateway</p-w>, <p-w s=H4191>and he died</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>just as</p-w> <p-w s=H376>the man</p-w> <p-w s=H430>of God</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>had foretold</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>when the king</p-w> <p-w s=H3381>had come</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to him</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1961>It happened</p-w> <p-w s=H376>just as the man</p-w> <p-w s=H430>of God</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>had told</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w>: “<p-w s=H6256>About this time</p-w> <p-w s=H4279>tomorrow</p-w> <p-w s=H8179>at the gate</p-w> <p-w s=H8111>of Samaria</p-w>, <p-w s=H5429>two seahs</p-w> <p-w s=H8184>of barley</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>will sell for a shekel</p-w>, <p-w s=H5429>and a seah</p-w> <p-w s=H5560>of fine flour</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>will sell</p-w> <p-w s=H8255>for a shekel</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H7991>And the officer</p-w> <p-w s=H6030>had answered</p-w> <p-w s=H376>the man</p-w> <p-w s=H430>of God</p-w>, “<p-w s=H2009>Look</p-w>, <p-w s=H3068>even if the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>were to make</p-w> <p-w s=H699>windows</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>in heaven</p-w>, <p-w s=H2088>could this</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>really happen</p-w>?” <p-w s=H559>So Elisha had replied</p-w>, <p-w s=H7200>You will see it</p-w> <p-w s=H5869>with your own eyes</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>but you will not</p-w> <p-w s=H398>eat</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>any of it</p-w>!”

¶ <p-w s=H3651>And that</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>is just what happened</p-w> to him. <p-w s=H5971>The people</p-w> <p-w s=H7429>trampled</p-w> <p-w s=H853>him</p-w> <p-w s=H8179>in the gateway</p-w>, <p-w s=H4191>and he died</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5650>Then his servants</p-w> <p-w s=H7392>carried him by chariot</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>to Jerusalem</p-w> <p-w s=H6912>and buried</p-w> <p-w s=H853>him</p-w> <p-w s=H1>with his fathers</p-w> <p-w s=H6900>in his tomb</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>in the City</p-w> <p-w s=H1732>of David</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H256>Now Ahab</p-w> <p-w s=H7657>had seventy</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>sons</p-w> <p-w s=H8111>in Samaria</p-w>. <p-w s=H3058>So Jehu</p-w> <p-w s=H3789>wrote</p-w> <p-w s=H5612>letters</p-w> <p-w s=H7971>and sent them</p-w> <p-w s=H8111>to Samaria</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H8269>the officials</p-w> <p-w s=H3157>of Jezreel</p-w>, <p-w s=H2205>to the elders</p-w>, <p-w s=H413>and to</p-w> <p-w s=H539>the guardians of the sons</p-w> <p-w s=H256>of Ahab</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>:

¶ <p-w s=H4397>When the messenger</p-w> <p-w s=H935>arrived</p-w>, <p-w s=H5046>he told</p-w> Jehu, “<p-w s=H935>They have brought</p-w> <p-w s=H7218>the heads</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>of the sons</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>of the king</p-w>.” <p-w s=H559>And Jehu ordered</p-w>, “<p-w s=H7760>Pile</p-w> <p-w s=H853>them</p-w> <p-w s=H8147>in two</p-w> <p-w s=H6652>heaps</p-w> <p-w s=H6607>at the entrance</p-w> <p-w s=H8179>of the gate</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>until</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H1980>When he left</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>there</p-w>, <p-w s=H4672>he found</p-w> <p-w s=H3082>Jehonadab</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H7394>of Rechab</p-w>, <p-w s=H7122>who was coming to meet him</p-w>. <p-w s=H1288>Jehu greeted him</p-w> <p-w s=H559>and asked</p-w>, “<p-w s=H3426>Is</p-w> <p-w s=H3824>your heart</p-w> <p-w s=H3477>as true to mine</p-w> <p-w s=H834>as</p-w> <p-w s=H3824>my heart</p-w> <p-w s=H5973>is</p-w> <p-w s=H3824>to yours</p-w>?” “<p-w s=H3426>It is</p-w>!” <p-w s=H3082>Jehonadab</p-w> <p-w s=H559>replied</p-w>. <p-w s=H3426>“If it is,” said Jehu</p-w>, “<p-w s=H5414>give</p-w> <p-w s=H853>me</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>your hand</p-w>.” <p-w s=H5414>So he gave him</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>his hand</p-w>, <p-w s=H5927>and Jehu helped him</p-w> <p-w s=H413>into</p-w> <p-w s=H4818>his chariot</p-w>,

¶ <p-w s=H935>When Jehu came</p-w> <p-w s=H8111>to Samaria</p-w>, <p-w s=H5221>he struck down</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>everyone</p-w> <p-w s=H256>belonging to Ahab</p-w> <p-w s=H7604>who remained</p-w> <p-w s=H8111>there</p-w>, <p-w s=H5704>until</p-w> <p-w s=H8045>he had destroyed them</p-w>, <p-w s=H1697>according to the word</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>had spoken</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H452>Elijah</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6258>Now, therefore</p-w>, <p-w s=H7121>summon</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to me</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H5030>the prophets</p-w> <p-w s=H1168>of Baal</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H5647>his servants</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H3548>his priests</p-w>. <p-w s=H376>See that no one</p-w> <p-w s=H6485>is missing</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> I have <p-w s=H1419>a great</p-w> <p-w s=H2077>sacrifice</p-w> <p-w s=H1168>for Baal</p-w>. <p-w s=H3605>Whoever</p-w> <p-w s=H6485>is missing</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>will not</p-w> <p-w s=H2421>live</p-w>.” <p-w s=H3058>But Jehu</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>was acting</p-w> <p-w s=H6122>deceptively</p-w> <p-w s=H4616>in order to</p-w> <p-w s=H6>destroy</p-w> <p-w s=H5647>the servants</p-w> <p-w s=H1168>of Baal</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2396>So Hezekiah</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H7971>sent</p-w> <p-w s=H413>word to</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H804>of Assyria</p-w> <p-w s=H3923>at Lachish</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>, “<p-w s=H2398>I have done wrong</p-w>; <p-w s=H7725>withdraw</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>from me</p-w>, <p-w s=H5375>and I will pay</p-w> <p-w s=H834>whatever</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>you demand</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>from me</p-w>.” <p-w s=H4428>And the king</p-w> <p-w s=H804>of Assyria</p-w> <p-w s=H7760>exacted</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>from</p-w> <p-w s=H2396>Hezekiah</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H7969>three</p-w> <p-w s=H3967>hundred</p-w> <p-w s=H3603>talents</p-w> <p-w s=H3701>of silver</p-w> <p-w s=H7970>and thirty</p-w> <p-w s=H3603>talents</p-w> <p-w s=H2091>of gold</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7121>Then they called</p-w> <p-w s=H413>for</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w>. <p-w s=H471>And Eliakim</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H2518>of Hilkiah</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>the palace</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>administrator</p-w>, <p-w s=H7644>Shebnah</p-w> <p-w s=H5608>the scribe</p-w>, <p-w s=H3098>and Joah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H623>of Asaph</p-w> <p-w s=H2142>the recorder</p-w>, <p-w s=H3318>went out</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to them</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H7262>The Rabshakeh</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to them</p-w>, “<p-w s=H559>Tell</p-w> <p-w s=H2396>Hezekiah</p-w> <p-w s=H3541>that this is what</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>the great</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w>, <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H804>of Assyria</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: <p-w s=H4100>What</p-w> <p-w s=H982>is the basis</p-w> <p-w s=H2088>of this</p-w> <p-w s=H986>confidence</p-w> <p-w s=H834>of yours</p-w>?

¶ <p-w s=H471>Then Eliakim</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H2518>of Hilkiah</p-w>, <p-w s=H7644>along with Shebnah</p-w> <p-w s=H3098>and Joah</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H7262>the Rabshakeh</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4994>Please</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>speak</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H5650>your servants</p-w> <p-w s=H762>in Aramaic</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>since</p-w> <p-w s=H587>we</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>understand it</p-w>. <p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>speak</p-w> <p-w s=H5973>with us</p-w> <p-w s=H3066>in Hebrew</p-w> <p-w s=H241>in the hearing</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>of the people</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H2346>the wall</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H7262>Then the Rabshakeh</p-w> <p-w s=H5975>stood</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>and called out</p-w> <p-w s=H6963>loudly</p-w> <p-w s=H3066>in Hebrew</p-w>: “<p-w s=H8085>Hear</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>the word</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>of the great</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w>, <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H804>of Assyria</p-w>!

<p-w s=H1908>Then Hadad</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>died</p-w>. <p-w s=H441>Now the chiefs</p-w> <p-w s=H123>of Edom were</p-w> <p-w s=H8555>Timna</p-w>, <p-w s=H5933>Alvah</p-w>, <p-w s=H3509>Jetheth</p-w>,
<p-w s=H173>Oholibamah</p-w>, <p-w s=H425>Elah</p-w>, <p-w s=H6373>Pinon</p-w>,
<p-w s=H7073>Kenaz</p-w>, <p-w s=H8487>Teman</p-w>, <p-w s=H4014>Mibzar</p-w>,
<p-w s=H4025>Magdiel</p-w>, <p-w s=H5902>and Iram</p-w>. <p-w s=H428>These</p-w> <p-w s=H441>were the chiefs</p-w> <p-w s=H123>of Edom</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3612>Caleb</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H2696>of Hezron</p-w> <p-w s=H3205>had children</p-w> <p-w s=H802>by his wife</p-w> <p-w s=H5806>Azubah</p-w> <p-w s=H3408>and by Jerioth</p-w>. <p-w s=H428>These were</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>the sons of Azubah</p-w>: <p-w s=H3475>Jesher</p-w>, <p-w s=H7727>Shobab</p-w>, <p-w s=H715>and Ardon</p-w>.
<p-w s=H5806>When Azubah</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>died</p-w>, <p-w s=H3612>Caleb</p-w> <p-w s=H3947>married</p-w> <p-w s=H672>Ephrath</p-w>, <p-w s=H3205>who bore</p-w> to him <p-w s=H2354>Hur</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3092>When Jehoshaphat</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>had returned</p-w> <p-w s=H7965>safely</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>his home</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>in Jerusalem</p-w>,

<p-w s=H559>Then he said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H8199>the judges</p-w>, “<p-w s=H7200>Consider carefully</p-w> <p-w s=H4100>what</p-w> <p-w s=H859>you</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>do</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>you are not</p-w> <p-w s=H8199>judging</p-w> <p-w s=H120>for man</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>but</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>for the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H5973>who is with you</p-w> <p-w s=H4941>when you render judgment</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H1571>Moreover</p-w>, <p-w s=H3092>Jehoshaphat</p-w> <p-w s=H5975>appointed</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>in Jerusalem</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>some of</p-w> <p-w s=H3881>the Levites</p-w>, <p-w s=H3548>priests</p-w>, <p-w s=H7218>and heads</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of the Israelite</p-w> <p-w s=H1>families</p-w> <p-w s=H4941>to judge</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>on behalf of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H7379>and to settle disputes</p-w>. <p-w s=H7725>And they lived</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>in Jerusalem</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6680>He commanded them</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>, “<p-w s=H6213>You must serve</p-w> <p-w s=H530>faithfully</p-w> <p-w s=H8003>and wholeheartedly</p-w> <p-w s=H3374>in the fear</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3605>For every</p-w> <p-w s=H7379>dispute</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H935>comes</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>before you</p-w> <p-w s=H251>from your brothers</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>who dwell</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>in their cities</p-w>— <p-w s=H996>whether</p-w> <p-w s=H1818>it regards bloodshed</p-w> <p-w s=H1818>or some other violation</p-w> <p-w s=H996>of</p-w> <p-w s=H8451>law</p-w>, <p-w s=H4687>commandments</p-w>, <p-w s=H2706>statutes</p-w>, <p-w s=H4941>or ordinances</p-w>— <p-w s=H2094>you are to warn them</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>so that they will not</p-w> <p-w s=H816>incur guilt</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>before the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H7110>and wrath</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>will not come</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>upon you</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>and</p-w> <p-w s=H251>your brothers</p-w>. <p-w s=H6213>Do</p-w> <p-w s=H3541>this</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>and you will not</p-w> <p-w s=H816>incur guilt</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H310>After this</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>the Moabites</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>and Ammonites</p-w>, <p-w s=H5973>together with</p-w> <p-w s=H5984>some of the Meunites</p-w>, <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> <p-w s=H4421>to make war</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>against</p-w> <p-w s=H3092>Jehoshaphat</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3427>They have lived</p-w> in the land <p-w s=H1129>and have built</p-w> in it <p-w s=H4720>a sanctuary</p-w> <p-w s=H8034>for Your Name</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>,

¶ <p-w s=H6258>And now</p-w>, <p-w s=H2009>here are</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>the men</p-w> <p-w s=H5983>of Ammon</p-w>, <p-w s=H4124>Moab</p-w>, <p-w s=H2022>and Mount</p-w> <p-w s=H8165>Seir</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>whom</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>You did not</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>let</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H935>invade</p-w> <p-w s=H935>when they came</p-w> <p-w s=H776>out of the land</p-w> <p-w s=H4714>of Egypt</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>So</p-w> <p-w s=H5493>Israel turned away</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>from them</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>and did not</p-w> <p-w s=H8045>destroy them</p-w>.

You <p-w s=H3808>need not</p-w> <p-w s=H3898>fight</p-w> <p-w s=H2063>this battle</p-w>. <p-w s=H3320>Take up your positions</p-w>, <p-w s=H5975>stand firm</p-w>, <p-w s=H7200>and see</p-w> <p-w s=H3444>the salvation</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H5973>on your behalf</p-w>, <p-w s=H3063>O Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>and Jerusalem</p-w>. <p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3372>be afraid</p-w> <p-w s=H2865>or discouraged</p-w>. <p-w s=H3318>Go out</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>and face them</p-w> <p-w s=H4279>tomorrow</p-w>, <p-w s=H3068>for the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H5973>is with you</p-w>.’”

¶ <p-w s=H3092>Then Jehoshaphat</p-w> <p-w s=H6915>bowed</p-w> <p-w s=H639>facedown</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>the people</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>and Jerusalem</p-w> <p-w s=H5307>fell down</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H7812>to worship</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>Him</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H6256>The moment</p-w> <p-w s=H2490>they began</p-w> <p-w s=H7440>their shouts</p-w> <p-w s=H8416>and praises</p-w>, <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>set</p-w> <p-w s=H693>ambushes</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>against the men</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>of Ammon</p-w>, <p-w s=H4124>Moab</p-w>, <p-w s=H2022>and Mount</p-w> <p-w s=H8165>Seir</p-w> <p-w s=H935>who had come</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>against Judah</p-w>, <p-w s=H5062>and they were defeated</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3063>When the men of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>to</p-w> <p-w s=H4707>a place overlooking</p-w> <p-w s=H4057>the wilderness</p-w>, <p-w s=H6437>they looked</p-w> <p-w s=H413>for</p-w> <p-w s=H1995>the vast army</p-w>, <p-w s=H2005>but there</p-w> <p-w s=H6297>were only corpses</p-w> <p-w s=H5307>lying</p-w> <p-w s=H776>on the ground</p-w>; <p-w s=H369>no one</p-w> <p-w s=H6413>had escaped</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3092>Then Jehoshaphat</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>and his people</p-w> <p-w s=H935>went</p-w> <p-w s=H962>to carry off</p-w> <p-w s=H7998>the plunder</p-w>, <p-w s=H4672>and they found</p-w> <p-w s=H6297>on the bodies</p-w> <p-w s=H7230>an abundance</p-w> <p-w s=H7399>of goods</p-w> <p-w s=H2532>and valuables</p-w>— <p-w s=H369>more than</p-w> <p-w s=H4853>they could carry away</p-w>. <p-w s=H1961>They were</p-w> <p-w s=H962>gathering</p-w> <p-w s=H7998>the plunder</p-w> <p-w s=H7969>for three</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>days</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>because</p-w> <p-w s=H7227>there was so much</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3605>Then all</p-w> <p-w s=H376>the men</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>and Jerusalem</p-w>, <p-w s=H3092>with Jehoshaphat</p-w> <p-w s=H7218>at their head</p-w>, <p-w s=H7725>returned</p-w> <p-w s=H8057>joyfully</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>Jerusalem</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H8055>had made them rejoice</p-w> <p-w s=H341>over their enemies</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3705>Now, therefore,</p-w> <p-w s=H2006>if</p-w> <p-w s=H2869>it pleases</p-w> <p-w s=H4430>the king</p-w>, <p-w s=H1240>let a search be made</p-w> <p-w s=H1768>of the royal</p-w> <p-w s=H1005>archives</p-w> <p-w s=H895>in Babylon</p-w> <p-w s=H2006>to see if</p-w> <p-w s=H4430>King</p-w> <p-w s=H3567>Cyrus</p-w> <p-w s=H7761>did indeed issue</p-w> <p-w s=H2942>a decree</p-w> <p-w s=H1124>to rebuild</p-w> <p-w s=H1791>the</p-w> <p-w s=H1005>house</p-w> <p-w s=H426>of God</p-w> <p-w s=H3390>in Jerusalem</p-w>. <p-w s=H4430>Then let the king</p-w> <p-w s=H7972>send</p-w> <p-w s=H5922>us</p-w> <p-w s=H7470>his decision</p-w> <p-w s=H5922>in</p-w> <p-w s=H1836>this matter</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4040>And a scroll</p-w> <p-w s=H7912>was found</p-w> <p-w s=H1001>in the fortress</p-w> <p-w s=H307>of Ecbatana</p-w>, <p-w s=H4083>in the province</p-w> <p-w s=H4076>of Media</p-w>, <p-w s=H3652>with the following</p-w> <p-w s=H3790>written</p-w> <p-w s=H1459>on it</p-w>: <p-w s=H1799>Memorandum</p-w>:

<p-w s=H638>Furthermore</p-w>, <p-w s=H1722>the gold</p-w> <p-w s=H3702>and silver</p-w> <p-w s=H3984>articles</p-w> <p-w s=H1005>of the house</p-w> <p-w s=H426>of God</p-w>, <p-w s=H1768>which</p-w> <p-w s=H5020>Nebuchadnezzar</p-w> <p-w s=H5312>took</p-w> <p-w s=H4481>from</p-w> <p-w s=H1965>the temple</p-w> <p-w s=H3390>in Jerusalem</p-w> <p-w s=H2987>and carried</p-w> <p-w s=H895>to Babylon</p-w>, <p-w s=H8421>must also be returned</p-w> <p-w s=H1965>to the temple</p-w> <p-w s=H3390>in Jerusalem</p-w> <p-w s=H5182>and deposited</p-w> <p-w s=H1005>in the house</p-w> <p-w s=H426>of God</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3705>Therefore Darius decreed</p-w>: <p-w s=H8674>To Tattenai</p-w> <p-w s=H6347>governor</p-w> <p-w s=H5675>of the region west</p-w> <p-w s=H5103>of the Euphrates</p-w>, <p-w s=H8370>Shethar-bozenai</p-w>, <p-w s=H3675>and your associates</p-w> <p-w s=H671>and officials</p-w> <p-w s=H5675>in the region</p-w>: <p-w s=H1934>You must stay</p-w> <p-w s=H7352>away</p-w> <p-w s=H4481>from</p-w> <p-w s=H8536>that place</p-w>!

<p-w s=H1768>Then</p-w> <p-w s=H1934>they will be able</p-w> <p-w s=H7127>to offer sacrifices</p-w> <p-w s=H5208>of a sweet aroma</p-w> <p-w s=H426>to the God</p-w> <p-w s=H8065>of heaven</p-w> <p-w s=H6739>and to pray</p-w> <p-w s=H2417>for the lives</p-w> <p-w s=H4430>of the king</p-w> <p-w s=H1123>and his sons</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H6153>At the evening</p-w> <p-w s=H4503>offering</p-w>, <p-w s=H6965>I got up</p-w> <p-w s=H8589>from my humiliation</p-w> <p-w s=H899>with my tunic</p-w> <p-w s=H4598>and cloak</p-w> <p-w s=H7167>torn</p-w>, <p-w s=H3766>and I fell</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H1290>my knees</p-w>, <p-w s=H6566>spread out</p-w> <p-w s=H3709>my hands</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H430>my God</p-w>,

<p-w s=H559>and said</p-w>: “<p-w s=H430>O my God</p-w>, <p-w s=H954>I am ashamed</p-w> <p-w s=H3637>and embarrassed</p-w> <p-w s=H7311>to lift up</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>my face</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to You</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>my God</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>because</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>our iniquities</p-w> <p-w s=H7235>are higher than</p-w> <p-w s=H7218>our heads</p-w>, <p-w s=H819>and our guilt</p-w> <p-w s=H1431>has reached</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>the heavens</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3117>From the days</p-w> <p-w s=H1>of our fathers</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>to</p-w> <p-w s=H2088>this</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>, <p-w s=H819>our guilt</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>has been great</p-w>. <p-w s=H5771>Because of our iniquities</p-w>, <p-w s=H587>we</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>and our kings</p-w> <p-w s=H3548>and priests</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>have been delivered</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>into the hands</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>of the kings</p-w> <p-w s=H776>of the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H2719>and subjected to the sword</p-w> <p-w s=H7628>and to captivity</p-w>, <p-w s=H961>to pillage</p-w> <p-w s=H1322>and humiliation</p-w>, <p-w s=H2088>as we are this</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6258>And now</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>our God</p-w>, <p-w s=H4100>what</p-w> <p-w s=H559>can we say</p-w> <p-w s=H310>after</p-w> <p-w s=H2063>this</p-w>? <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H5800>we have forsaken</p-w> <p-w s=H4687>the commandments</p-w>

<p-w s=H310>After</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H935>that has come</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>upon us</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>because of our evil</p-w> <p-w s=H4639>deeds</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>and our great</p-w> <p-w s=H819>guilt</p-w> (<p-w s=H3588>though</p-w> <p-w s=H859>You</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>our God</p-w>, <p-w s=H2820>have punished us</p-w> <p-w s=H4295>less</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>than our iniquities deserve</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>and have given</p-w> us <p-w s=H6413>such a remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H2063>as this</p-w>),

¶ <p-w s=H5830>While Ezra</p-w> <p-w s=H6419>prayed</p-w> <p-w s=H3034>and made this confession</p-w>, <p-w s=H1058>weeping</p-w> <p-w s=H5307>and falling facedown</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>the house</p-w> <p-w s=H430>of God</p-w>, <p-w s=H3966>a very</p-w> <p-w s=H7227>large</p-w> <p-w s=H6951>assembly</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israelites</p-w>— <p-w s=H582>men</p-w>, <p-w s=H802>women</p-w>, <p-w s=H3206>and children</p-w>— <p-w s=H6908>gathered</p-w> <p-w s=H413>around him</p-w>, <p-w s=H5971>and the people</p-w> <p-w s=H1058>wept bitterly</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>as well</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3068>O LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H7522>You favored me</p-w>; <p-w s=H5975>You made</p-w> <p-w s=H2042>my mountain</p-w> <p-w s=H5797>{stand} strong</p-w>. <p-w s=H5641>When You hid</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>Your face</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>I was</p-w> <p-w s=H926>dismayed</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4616>that my heart</p-w> <p-w s=H2167>may sing</p-w> <p-w s=H3519>Your praises</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>and not</p-w> <p-w s=H1826>be silent</p-w>. <p-w s=H3068>O LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H430>my God</p-w>, <p-w s=H3034>I will give thanks</p-w> <p-w s=H5769>forever</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6256>My times</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>are in Your hands</p-w>; <p-w s=H5337>deliver me</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>from</p-w> <p-w s=H341>my enemies</p-w> <p-w s=H7291>and from those who pursue me</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2795>But like a deaf man</p-w>, <p-w s=H589>I</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>do not</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>hear</p-w>; <p-w s=H483>and like a mute man</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>I do not</p-w> <p-w s=H6605>open</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>my mouth</p-w>.

<p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H5800>forsake me</p-w>, <p-w s=H3068>O LORD</p-w>; <p-w s=H408>be not</p-w> <p-w s=H7368>far</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>from me</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>O my God</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5329>For the choirmaster</p-w>. <p-w s=H3038>For Jeduthun</p-w>. <p-w s=H4210>A Psalm</p-w> <p-w s=H1732>of David</p-w>. <p-w s=H559>I said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H8104>I will watch</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>my ways</p-w> <p-w s=H2398>so that I will not sin</p-w> <p-w s=H3956>with my tongue</p-w>; <p-w s=H8104>I will guard</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>my mouth</p-w> <p-w s=H4269>with a muzzle</p-w> <p-w s=H5750>as long as</p-w> <p-w s=H7563>the wicked</p-w> <p-w s=H5048>are present</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H6258>And now</p-w>, <p-w s=H136>O Lord</p-w>, <p-w s=H4100>for what</p-w> <p-w s=H6960>do I wait</p-w>? <p-w s=H8431>My hope is</p-w> in <p-w s=H1931>You</p-w>.

<p-w s=H589>But I am</p-w> <p-w s=H6041>poor</p-w> <p-w s=H34>and needy</p-w>; <p-w s=H136>may the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H2803>think</p-w> of me. <p-w s=H859>You</p-w> <p-w s=H5833>are my helper</p-w> <p-w s=H6403>and deliverer</p-w>; <p-w s=H430>O my God</p-w>, <p-w s=H408>do not</p-w> <p-w s=H309>delay</p-w>.

<p-w s=H982>They trust</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>in</p-w> <p-w s=H2428>their wealth</p-w> <p-w s=H1984>and boast</p-w> <p-w s=H7230>in their great</p-w> <p-w s=H6239>riches</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2421>that he should live on</p-w> <p-w s=H5331>forever</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>and not</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>see</p-w> <p-w s=H7845>decay</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7130>Their graves</p-w> <p-w s=H5769>are their eternal</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>homes</p-w>— <p-w s=H4908>their dwellings</p-w> <p-w s=H1755>for endless generations</p-w>— <p-w s=H5921>even though</p-w> <p-w s=H127>their lands</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>were their namesakes</p-w>.

<p-w s=H120>But a man</p-w>, <p-w s=H3366>despite his wealth</p-w>, <p-w s=H1077>cannot</p-w> <p-w s=H3885>endure</p-w>; <p-w s=H4911>he is like</p-w> <p-w s=H929>the beasts</p-w> <p-w s=H1820>that perish</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2088>This</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>is the fate</p-w> <p-w s=H3689>of the foolish</p-w> <p-w s=H310>and their followers</p-w> <p-w s=H7521>who endorse</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>their sayings</p-w>. <p-w s=H5542>Selah</p-w>

<p-w s=H6629>Like sheep</p-w> <p-w s=H8371>they are destined</p-w> <p-w s=H7585>for Sheol</p-w>. <p-w s=H4194>Death</p-w> <p-w s=H7462>will be their shepherd</p-w>. <p-w s=H3477>The upright</p-w> <p-w s=H7287>will rule them</p-w> in <p-w s=H1242>the morning</p-w>, <p-w s=H6736>and their form</p-w> <p-w s=H1086>will decay</p-w> <p-w s=H7585>in Sheol</p-w>, <p-w s=H2073>far from their lofty abode</p-w>.

<p-w s=H389>But</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H6299>will redeem</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>my life</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>from</p-w> <p-w s=H7585>Sheol</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H3947>He will surely take me to Himself</p-w>. <p-w s=H5542>Selah</p-w>

<p-w s=H3588>Though</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>in his lifetime</p-w> <p-w s=H1288>he blesses</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>his soul</p-w>— <p-w s=H3034>and men praise</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>you when</p-w> <p-w s=H3190>you prosper</p-w>—
<p-w s=H935>he will join</p-w> <p-w s=H1755>the generation</p-w> <p-w s=H1>of his fathers</p-w>, <p-w s=H5704>who will never</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>see</p-w> <p-w s=H216>the light of day</p-w>.

<p-w s=H120>A man</p-w> <p-w s=H3366>who has riches</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>without</p-w> <p-w s=H995>understanding</p-w> <p-w s=H4911>is like</p-w> <p-w s=H929>the beasts</p-w> <p-w s=H1820>that perish</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4210>A Psalm</p-w> <p-w s=H623>of Asaph</p-w>. <p-w s=H410>The Mighty One</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H1696>speaks</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>and summons</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H4217>from where the sun rises</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3996>where it sets</p-w>.

<p-w s=H8064>And the heavens</p-w> <p-w s=H5046>proclaim</p-w> <p-w s=H6664>His righteousness</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1931>Himself</p-w> <p-w s=H8199>is Judge</p-w>. <p-w s=H5542>Selah</p-w>

“<p-w s=H8085>Hear</p-w>, <p-w s=H5971>O My people</p-w>, <p-w s=H1696>and I will speak</p-w>, <p-w s=H3478>O Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H5749>and I will testify</p-w> against you: <p-w s=H595>I</p-w> <p-w s=H430>am God</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>your God</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3808>I do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3198>rebuke</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>you for</p-w> <p-w s=H2077>your sacrifices</p-w>, <p-w s=H5930>and your burnt offerings</p-w> <p-w s=H8548>are ever</p-w> <p-w s=H5048>before Me</p-w>.
<p-w s=H3808>I have no</p-w> <p-w s=H3947>need</p-w> <p-w s=H6499>for a bull</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>from your stall</p-w> <p-w s=H6260>or goats</p-w> <p-w s=H4356>from your pens</p-w>,

<p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>every</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>beast</p-w> <p-w s=H3293>of the forest</p-w> is Mine— <p-w s=H929>the cattle</p-w> <p-w s=H505>on a thousand</p-w> <p-w s=H2042>hills</p-w>.

<p-w s=H518>If</p-w> <p-w s=H7456>I were hungry</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>I would not</p-w> <p-w s=H559>tell</p-w> you, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H8398>the world</p-w> is Mine, <p-w s=H4393>and the fullness thereof</p-w>.
<p-w s=H398>Do I eat</p-w> <p-w s=H1320>the flesh</p-w> <p-w s=H47>of bulls</p-w>, <p-w s=H8354>or drink</p-w> <p-w s=H1818>the blood</p-w> <p-w s=H6260>of goats</p-w>?
<p-w s=H2076>Sacrifice</p-w> <p-w s=H8426>a thank offering</p-w> <p-w s=H430>to God</p-w>, <p-w s=H7999>and fulfill</p-w> <p-w s=H5088>your vows</p-w> <p-w s=H5945>to the Most High</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7563>To the wicked, however</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4100>What right</p-w> have you <p-w s=H5608>to recite</p-w> <p-w s=H2706>My statutes</p-w> <p-w s=H5375>and to bear</p-w> <p-w s=H1285>My covenant</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>your lips</p-w>?
<p-w s=H859>For you</p-w> <p-w s=H8130>hate</p-w> <p-w s=H4148>My instruction</p-w> <p-w s=H7993>and cast</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>My words</p-w> <p-w s=H310>behind you</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7971>You unleash</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>your mouth</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>for evil</p-w> <p-w s=H6775>and harness</p-w> <p-w s=H3956>your tongue</p-w> <p-w s=H4820>to deceit</p-w>.
<p-w s=H3427>You sit</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>and malign</p-w> <p-w s=H251>your brother</p-w>; <p-w s=H5414>you</p-w> <p-w s=H1848>slander</p-w> <p-w s=H517>your own mother’s</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6213>You have done</p-w> <p-w s=H428>these things</p-w>, <p-w s=H2790>and I kept silent</p-w>; <p-w s=H1819>you thought</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>I was</p-w> <p-w s=H3644>just like you</p-w>. <p-w s=H3198>But now I rebuke you</p-w> <p-w s=H6186>and accuse you</p-w> <p-w s=H5869>to your face</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4994>Now</p-w> <p-w s=H995>consider</p-w> <p-w s=H2063>this</p-w>, <p-w s=H7911>you who forget</p-w> <p-w s=H433>God</p-w>, <p-w s=H6435>lest</p-w> <p-w s=H2963>I tear you to pieces</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>with no one</p-w> <p-w s=H5337>to rescue you</p-w>:

<p-w s=H5329>For the choirmaster</p-w>. <p-w s=H4210>A Psalm</p-w> <p-w s=H1732>of David</p-w>. <p-w s=H5416>When Nathan</p-w> <p-w s=H5030>the prophet</p-w> <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to him</p-w> <p-w s=H834>after</p-w> <p-w s=H935>his adultery</p-w> <p-w s=H413>with</p-w> <p-w s=H1339>Bathsheba</p-w>. <p-w s=H2603>Have mercy on me</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>O God</p-w>, <p-w s=H2617>according to Your loving devotion</p-w>; <p-w s=H7230>according to Your great</p-w> <p-w s=H7356>compassion</p-w>, <p-w s=H4229>blot out</p-w> <p-w s=H6588>my transgressions</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1254>Create</p-w> in me <p-w s=H2889>a clean</p-w> <p-w s=H3820>heart</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>O God</p-w>, <p-w s=H2318>and renew</p-w> <p-w s=H3559>a right</p-w> <p-w s=H7307>spirit</p-w> <p-w s=H7130>within me</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7725>Restore</p-w> to me <p-w s=H8342>the joy</p-w> <p-w s=H3468>of Your salvation</p-w>, <p-w s=H5564>and sustain me</p-w> <p-w s=H5081>with a willing</p-w> <p-w s=H7307>spirit</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5337>Deliver me</p-w> <p-w s=H1818>from bloodguilt</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>O God</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>the God</p-w> <p-w s=H8668>of my salvation</p-w>, <p-w s=H3956>and my tongue</p-w> <p-w s=H7442>will sing</p-w> <p-w s=H6666>of Your righteousness</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>You do not</p-w> <p-w s=H2654>delight</p-w> <p-w s=H2077>in sacrifice</p-w>, <p-w s=H5414>or I would bring it</p-w>; <p-w s=H7521>You take no pleasure</p-w> <p-w s=H5930>in burnt offerings</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7522>In Your good pleasure</p-w>, <p-w s=H6726>cause Zion</p-w> <p-w s=H3190>to prosper</p-w>; <p-w s=H1129>build up</p-w> <p-w s=H2346>the walls</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>of Jerusalem</p-w>.
