<p-w s=H389>But</p-w> <p-w s=H3381>you will be brought down</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H7585>Sheol</p-w>, <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3411>the lowest depths</p-w> <p-w s=H953>of the Pit</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7200>Those who see you</p-w> <p-w s=H7688>will stare</p-w>; <p-w s=H995>they will ponder</p-w> <p-w s=H413>your fate</p-w>: “<p-w s=H2088>Is this</p-w> <p-w s=H376>the man</p-w> <p-w s=H7264>who shook</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H4467>and made the kingdoms</p-w> <p-w s=H7493>tremble</p-w>,

<p-w s=H7760>who turned</p-w> <p-w s=H8398>the world</p-w> <p-w s=H4057>into a desert</p-w> <p-w s=H2040>and destroyed</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>its cities</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>who refused</p-w> <p-w s=H6605>to let</p-w> <p-w s=H615>the captives</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>return to their homes</p-w>?”
<p-w s=H3605>All</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the kings</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>of the nations</p-w> <p-w s=H7901>lie</p-w> <p-w s=H3519>in state</p-w>, <p-w s=H376>each</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>in his own tomb</p-w>.

<p-w s=H859>But you</p-w> <p-w s=H7993>are cast out</p-w> <p-w s=H6913>of your grave</p-w> <p-w s=H8581>like a rejected</p-w> <p-w s=H5342>branch</p-w>, <p-w s=H3830>covered</p-w> <p-w s=H2026>by those slain</p-w> <p-w s=H2719>with the sword</p-w>, <p-w s=H3381>and dumped</p-w> <p-w s=H413>into</p-w> <p-w s=H68>a rocky</p-w> <p-w s=H953>pit</p-w> <p-w s=H6297>like a carcass</p-w> <p-w s=H947>trampled underfoot</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3808>You will not</p-w> <p-w s=H3161>join them</p-w> <p-w s=H6900>in burial</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>since</p-w> <p-w s=H7843>you have destroyed</p-w> <p-w s=H776>your land</p-w> <p-w s=H2026>and slaughtered</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>your own people</p-w>. <p-w s=H2233>The offspring</p-w> <p-w s=H7489>of the wicked</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>will never again</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>be mentioned</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3559>Prepare</p-w> <p-w s=H4293>a place to slaughter</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>his sons</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>for the iniquities</p-w> <p-w s=H1>of their forefathers</p-w>. <p-w s=H1077>They will never</p-w> <p-w s=H6965>rise up</p-w> <p-w s=H3423>to possess</p-w> <p-w s=H776>a land</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>or cover</p-w> <p-w s=H8398>the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H4390>with their</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>cities</p-w>.

“<p-w s=H6965>I will rise up</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>against them</p-w>,” <p-w s=H5002>declares</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6635>of Hosts</p-w>. “<p-w s=H3772>I will cut off</p-w> <p-w s=H894>from Babylon</p-w> <p-w s=H8034>her name</p-w> <p-w s=H7605>and her remnant</p-w>, <p-w s=H5209>her offspring</p-w> <p-w s=H5220>and her posterity</p-w>,” <p-w s=H5002>declares</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w>.

“<p-w s=H7760>I will make her</p-w> <p-w s=H4180>a place</p-w> <p-w s=H7090>for owls</p-w> <p-w s=H98>and for swamplands</p-w>; <p-w s=H2894>I will sweep her away</p-w> <p-w s=H4292>with the broom</p-w> <p-w s=H8045>of destruction</p-w>,” <p-w s=H5002>declares</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6635>of Hosts</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3068>The LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6635>of Hosts</p-w> <p-w s=H7650>has sworn</p-w>: “<p-w s=H518>Surely</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>as</p-w> <p-w s=H1819>I have planned</p-w>, <p-w s=H3651>so</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>will it be</p-w>; <p-w s=H834>as</p-w> <p-w s=H3289>I have purposed</p-w>, <p-w s=H6965>so will it stand</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7665>I will break</p-w> <p-w s=H804>Assyria</p-w> <p-w s=H776>in My land</p-w>; <p-w s=H947>I will trample him</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H2022>My mountain</p-w>. <p-w s=H5923>His yoke</p-w> <p-w s=H5493>will be taken</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>off My people</p-w>, <p-w s=H5448>and his burden</p-w> <p-w s=H5493>removed</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>from</p-w> <p-w s=H7926>their shoulders</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H2063>This</p-w> <p-w s=H6098>is the plan</p-w> <p-w s=H3289>devised</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>for</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>the whole</p-w> <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>, <p-w s=H2063>and this</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>is the hand</p-w> <p-w s=H5186>stretched out</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>over</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>the nations</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3068>The LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6635>of Hosts</p-w> <p-w s=H3289>has purposed</p-w>, <p-w s=H4310>and who</p-w> <p-w s=H6565>can thwart Him</p-w>? <p-w s=H3027>His hand</p-w> <p-w s=H5186>is outstretched</p-w>, <p-w s=H4310>so who</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>can turn it back</p-w>?
¶ <p-w s=H8141>In the year</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>that King</p-w> <p-w s=H271>Ahaz</p-w> <p-w s=H4194>died</p-w>, <p-w s=H2088>this</p-w> <p-w s=H4853>burden</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>was received</p-w>:

<p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H8055>rejoice</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H6429>you Philistines</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H7626>the rod</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>that struck you</p-w> <p-w s=H7665>is broken</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H6848>a viper</p-w> <p-w s=H3318>will spring</p-w> <p-w s=H8328>from the root</p-w> <p-w s=H5175>of the snake</p-w>, <p-w s=H5774>and a flying</p-w> <p-w s=H8314>serpent</p-w> <p-w s=H6529>from its egg</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1060>Then the firstborn</p-w> <p-w s=H1800>of the poor</p-w> <p-w s=H7462>will find pasture</p-w>, <p-w s=H34>and the needy</p-w> <p-w s=H7257>will lie down</p-w> <p-w s=H983>in safety</p-w>, <p-w s=H4191>but I will kill</p-w> <p-w s=H8328>your root</p-w> <p-w s=H7458>by famine</p-w>, <p-w s=H7611>and your remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H2026>will be slain</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3213>Wail</p-w>, <p-w s=H8179>O gate</p-w>! <p-w s=H2199>Cry out</p-w>, <p-w s=H5892>O city</p-w>! <p-w s=H4127>Melt away</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H6429>you Philistines</p-w>! <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H6227>a cloud of smoke</p-w> <p-w s=H935>comes</p-w> <p-w s=H6828>from the north</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>and there are no</p-w> <p-w s=H909>stragglers</p-w> <p-w s=H4151>in its ranks</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4100>What</p-w> <p-w s=H6030>answer will be given</p-w> <p-w s=H4397>to the envoys</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>of that nation</p-w>? “<p-w s=H3068>The LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H3245>has founded</p-w> <p-w s=H6726>Zion</p-w>, <p-w s=H6041>where His afflicted</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w> <p-w s=H2620>will find refuge</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H4853>This is the burden</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>against Moab</p-w>: <p-w s=H6144>Ar</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>in Moab</p-w> <p-w s=H7703>is ruined</p-w>, <p-w s=H1820>destroyed</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>in a night</p-w>! <p-w s=H7024>Kir</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>in Moab</p-w> <p-w s=H7703>is devastated</p-w>, <p-w s=H1820>destroyed</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>in a night</p-w>!

<p-w s=H1769>Dibon</p-w> <p-w s=H5927>goes up</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>to its temple</p-w> <p-w s=H1065>to weep</p-w> <p-w s=H1116>at its high places</p-w>. <p-w s=H4124>Moab</p-w> <p-w s=H3213>wails</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>over</p-w> <p-w s=H5015>Nebo</p-w>, <p-w s=H5921>as well as over</p-w> <p-w s=H4311>Medeba</p-w>. <p-w s=H3605>Every</p-w> <p-w s=H7218>head</p-w> <p-w s=H7144>is shaved</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>every</p-w> <p-w s=H2206>beard</p-w> <p-w s=H1639>is cut off</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2351>In its streets</p-w> <p-w s=H2296>they wear</p-w> <p-w s=H8242>sackcloth</p-w>; <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H1406>the rooftops</p-w> <p-w s=H7339>and in the public squares</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>they all</p-w> <p-w s=H3213>wail</p-w>, <p-w s=H3381>falling down</p-w> <p-w s=H1065>weeping</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2809>Heshbon</p-w> <p-w s=H500>and Elealeh</p-w> <p-w s=H2199>cry out</p-w>; <p-w s=H6963>their voices</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>are heard</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>as far as</p-w> <p-w s=H3096>Jahaz</p-w>. <p-w s=H5921>Therefore</p-w> <p-w s=H2502>the soldiers</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>of Moab</p-w> <p-w s=H7321>cry out</p-w>; <p-w s=H5315>their souls</p-w> <p-w s=H3415>tremble</p-w> within.

<p-w s=H3820>My heart</p-w> <p-w s=H2199>cries out</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>over Moab</p-w>; <p-w s=H1281>her fugitives</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>flee as</p-w> <p-w s=H6820>far as Zoar</p-w>, <p-w s=H5697>as far as Eglath-shelishiyah</p-w>. <p-w s=H1065>With weeping</p-w> <p-w s=H5927>they ascend</p-w> <p-w s=H4608>the slope</p-w> <p-w s=H3872>of Luhith</p-w>; <p-w s=H5782>they lament</p-w> <p-w s=H7667>their destruction</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>on the road</p-w> <p-w s=H2773>to Horonaim</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4325>The waters</p-w> <p-w s=H5249>of Nimrim</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>are</p-w> <p-w s=H4923>dried up</p-w>, <p-w s=H2682>and the grass</p-w> <p-w s=H3001>is withered</p-w>; <p-w s=H1877>the vegetation</p-w> <p-w s=H3615>is gone</p-w>, <p-w s=H3418>and the greenery</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>is</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>no more</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5921>So</p-w> <p-w s=H5375>they carry</p-w> <p-w s=H3502>their wealth</p-w> <p-w s=H6486>and belongings</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>over</p-w> <p-w s=H5158>the Brook</p-w> <p-w s=H6155>of the Willows</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H2201>their outcry</p-w> <p-w s=H5362>echoes</p-w> <p-w s=H1366>to the border</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>of Moab</p-w>. <p-w s=H3215>Their wailing</p-w> <p-w s=H97>reaches Eglaim</p-w>; <p-w s=H3215>it is heard</p-w> <p-w s=H879>in Beer-elim</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4325>The waters</p-w> <p-w s=H1775>of Dimon</p-w> <p-w s=H4390>are full of</p-w> <p-w s=H1818>blood</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>but</p-w> <p-w s=H7896>I will bring</p-w> <p-w s=H3254>more</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>upon</p-w> <p-w s=H1775>Dimon</p-w>— <p-w s=H738>a lion</p-w> <p-w s=H6413>upon the fugitives</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>of Moab</p-w> <p-w s=H7611>and upon the remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H127>of the land</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7971>Send</p-w> <p-w s=H3733>the tribute lambs</p-w> <p-w s=H4910>to the ruler</p-w> <p-w s=H776>of the land</p-w>, <p-w s=H5554>from Sela</p-w> <p-w s=H4057>in the desert</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H2022>the mount</p-w> <p-w s=H1323>of Daughter</p-w> <p-w s=H6726>Zion</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5775>Like fluttering birds</p-w> <p-w s=H7971>pushed</p-w> <p-w s=H7064>out of the nest</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>so are</p-w> <p-w s=H1323>the daughters</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>of Moab</p-w> <p-w s=H4569>at the fords</p-w> <p-w s=H769>of the Arnon</p-w>:

“<p-w s=H935>Give us</p-w> <p-w s=H6098>counsel</p-w>; <p-w s=H6213>render</p-w> <p-w s=H6415>a decision</p-w>. <p-w s=H6672>Shelter us at noonday</p-w> <p-w s=H6738>with shade</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>as dark as night</p-w>. <p-w s=H5641>Hide</p-w> <p-w s=H5080>the refugees</p-w>; <p-w s=H408>do not</p-w> <p-w s=H1540>betray</p-w> <p-w s=H5074>the one who flees</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5080>Let my fugitives</p-w> <p-w s=H1481>stay</p-w> with you; <p-w s=H1933>be</p-w> <p-w s=H5643>a refuge</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>for Moab</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>from</p-w> <p-w s=H7703>the destroyer</p-w>.” <p-w s=H3588>When</p-w> <p-w s=H4160>the oppressor</p-w> <p-w s=H656>has gone</p-w>, <p-w s=H7701>destruction</p-w> <p-w s=H3615>has ceased</p-w>, <p-w s=H7429>and the oppressors</p-w> <p-w s=H8552>have vanished</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>from</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w>,

<p-w s=H2617>in loving devotion</p-w> <p-w s=H3678>a throne</p-w> <p-w s=H3559>will be established</p-w> <p-w s=H168>in the tent</p-w> <p-w s=H1732>of David</p-w>. <p-w s=H8199>A judge</p-w> <p-w s=H1875>seeking</p-w> <p-w s=H4941>justice</p-w> <p-w s=H4106>and hastening</p-w> <p-w s=H6664>righteousness</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>will sit</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on it</p-w> <p-w s=H571>in faithfulness</p-w>.

<p-w s=H8085>We have heard</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>of Moab’s</p-w> <p-w s=H1347>pomposity</p-w>, <p-w s=H3966>his exceeding</p-w> <p-w s=H1341>pride</p-w> <p-w s=H1346>and conceit</p-w>, <p-w s=H5678>his overflowing</p-w> <p-w s=H1347>arrogance</p-w>. <p-w s=H907>But his boasting</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>is empty</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3651>Therefore</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>let Moab</p-w> <p-w s=H3213>wail</p-w>; <p-w s=H3213>let them wail</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>together</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>for Moab</p-w>. <p-w s=H1897>Moan</p-w> <p-w s=H809>for the raisin cakes</p-w> <p-w s=H7025>of Kir-hareseth</p-w>, <p-w s=H389>you who are utterly</p-w> <p-w s=H5218>stricken</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H7709>the fields</p-w> <p-w s=H2809>of Heshbon</p-w> <p-w s=H535>have withered</p-w>, <p-w s=H1612>along with the grapevines</p-w> <p-w s=H7643>of Sibmah</p-w>. <p-w s=H1167>The rulers</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>of the nations</p-w> <p-w s=H1986>have trampled</p-w> <p-w s=H8291>its choicest vines</p-w>, <p-w s=H5060>which had reached</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>as</p-w> <p-w s=H3270>far as Jazer</p-w> <p-w s=H8582>and spread</p-w> <p-w s=H4057>toward the desert</p-w>. <p-w s=H7976>Their shoots</p-w> <p-w s=H5203>had spread out</p-w> <p-w s=H5674>and passed over</p-w> <p-w s=H3220>the sea</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5921>So</p-w> <p-w s=H1058>I weep</p-w> <p-w s=H3270>with Jazer</p-w> <p-w s=H1612>for the vines</p-w> <p-w s=H7643>of Sibmah</p-w>; <p-w s=H7301>I drench</p-w> <p-w s=H2809>Heshbon</p-w> <p-w s=H500>and Elealeh</p-w> <p-w s=H1832>with my tears</p-w>. <p-w s=H1959>Triumphant shouts</p-w> <p-w s=H5307>have fallen silent</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>over</p-w> <p-w s=H7019>your summer fruit</p-w> <p-w s=H7105>and your harvest</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3651>so</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H804>of Assyria</p-w> <p-w s=H5090>will lead away</p-w> <p-w s=H7628>the captives</p-w> <p-w s=H4714>of Egypt</p-w> <p-w s=H1546>and the exiles</p-w> <p-w s=H3568>of Cush</p-w>, <p-w s=H5288>young</p-w> <p-w s=H2205>and old alike</p-w>, <p-w s=H6174>naked</p-w> <p-w s=H3182>and barefoot</p-w>, <p-w s=H2834>with bared</p-w> <p-w s=H8357>buttocks</p-w>— <p-w s=H4714>to Egypt’s</p-w> <p-w s=H6172>shame</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H4853>This is the burden</p-w> <p-w s=H6152>against Arabia</p-w>: <p-w s=H3293>In the thickets</p-w> <p-w s=H6152>of Arabia</p-w> <p-w s=H3885>you must lodge</p-w>, <p-w s=H736>O caravans</p-w> <p-w s=H1720>of Dedanites</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6258>But now</p-w>, <p-w s=H3541>this is what</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>— <p-w s=H1254>He who created you</p-w>, <p-w s=H3290>O Jacob</p-w>, <p-w s=H3335>and He who formed you</p-w>, <p-w s=H3478>O Israel</p-w>: “<p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3372>fear</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H1350>I have redeemed you</p-w>; <p-w s=H7121>I have called</p-w> <p-w s=H8034>you by your name</p-w>; <p-w s=H859>you are</p-w> Mine!

<p-w s=H2142>Remind Me</p-w>, <p-w s=H8199>let us argue the matter</p-w> <p-w s=H3162>together</p-w>. <p-w s=H5608>State your case</p-w>, <p-w s=H4616>so that</p-w> <p-w s=H859>you</p-w> <p-w s=H6663>may be vindicated</p-w>.
<p-w s=H7223>Your first</p-w> <p-w s=H1>father</p-w> <p-w s=H2398>sinned</p-w>, <p-w s=H3887>and your spokesmen</p-w> <p-w s=H6586>rebelled</p-w> against Me.

<p-w s=H2490>So I will disgrace</p-w> <p-w s=H8269>the princes</p-w> <p-w s=H6944>of your sanctuary</p-w>, <p-w s=H5414>and I will devote</p-w> <p-w s=H3290>Jacob</p-w> <p-w s=H2764>to destruction</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>and Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H1421>to reproach</p-w>.”
<p-w s=H6258>But now</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>listen</p-w>, <p-w s=H3290>O Jacob</p-w> <p-w s=H5650>My servant</p-w>, <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H977>whom I have chosen</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3541>This</p-w> <p-w s=H559>is the word</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H6213>your Maker</p-w>, <p-w s=H3335>who formed you</p-w> <p-w s=H990>from the womb</p-w> <p-w s=H5826>and who will help you</p-w>: “<p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3372>be afraid</p-w>, <p-w s=H3290>O Jacob</p-w> <p-w s=H5650>My servant</p-w>, <p-w s=H3484>Jeshurun</p-w>, <p-w s=H977>whom I have chosen</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H3332>I will pour</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>water</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H6771>the thirsty land</p-w>, <p-w s=H5140>and currents</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H3004>the dry ground</p-w>. <p-w s=H3332>I will pour out</p-w> <p-w s=H7307>My Spirit</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>your descendants</p-w>, <p-w s=H1293>and My blessing</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H6631>your offspring</p-w>.
<p-w s=H6779>They will sprout</p-w> <p-w s=H996>among</p-w> <p-w s=H2682>the grass</p-w> <p-w s=H6155>like willows</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>by</p-w> <p-w s=H2988>flowing</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>streams</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2088>One</p-w> <p-w s=H559>will say</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H589>I belong</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>to the LORD</p-w>,’ <p-w s=H2088>another</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>will call himself</p-w> <p-w s=H8034>by the name</p-w> <p-w s=H3290>of Jacob</p-w>, <p-w s=H2088>and still another</p-w> <p-w s=H3789>will write</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>on his hand</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H3068>The LORD’s</p-w>,’ <p-w s=H3655>and will take</p-w> <p-w s=H8034>the name</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H3541>Thus</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H4428>the King</p-w> <p-w s=H1350>and Redeemer</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6635>of Hosts</p-w>: “<p-w s=H589>I</p-w> <p-w s=H7223>am the first</p-w> <p-w s=H589>and I am</p-w> <p-w s=H314>the last</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>and there is no</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1107>but Me</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4310>Who then is</p-w> <p-w s=H3644>like Me</p-w>? <p-w s=H7121>Let him say so</p-w>! <p-w s=H5046>Let him declare</p-w> <p-w s=H6186>his case</p-w> before Me, <p-w s=H7760>since I established</p-w> <p-w s=H5769>an ancient</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w>. <p-w s=H5046>Let him foretell</p-w> <p-w s=H857>the things to come</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>and what</p-w> <p-w s=H935>is to take place</p-w>.

<p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H6342>tremble</p-w> <p-w s=H408>or</p-w> <p-w s=H7297>fear</p-w>. <p-w s=H3808>Have I not</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>told you</p-w> <p-w s=H5046>and declared it</p-w> <p-w s=H227>long ago</p-w>? <p-w s=H859>You</p-w> <p-w s=H5707>are My witnesses</p-w>! <p-w s=H3426>Is there</p-w> <p-w s=H433>any God</p-w> <p-w s=H1107>but Me</p-w>? <p-w s=H369>There is no</p-w> <p-w s=H6697>other Rock</p-w>; <p-w s=H3045>I know</p-w> <p-w s=H1077>not one</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H3605>All</p-w> <p-w s=H3335>makers</p-w> <p-w s=H6459>of idols</p-w> <p-w s=H8414>are nothing</p-w>, <p-w s=H2530>and the things they treasure</p-w> <p-w s=H3276>are worthless</p-w>. <p-w s=H5707>Their witnesses</p-w> <p-w s=H1077>fail to</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>see</p-w> <p-w s=H3045>or comprehend</p-w>, <p-w s=H4616>so</p-w> <p-w s=H954>they are put to shame</p-w>.
<p-w s=H4310>Who</p-w> <p-w s=H3335>fashions</p-w> <p-w s=H410>a god</p-w> <p-w s=H5258>or casts</p-w> <p-w s=H6459>an idol</p-w> <p-w s=H3276>which profits him</p-w> <p-w s=H1115>nothing</p-w>?

<p-w s=H2005>Behold</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H2270>his companions</p-w> <p-w s=H954>will be put to shame</p-w>, <p-w s=H2796>for the craftsmen</p-w> <p-w s=H1992>themselves</p-w> <p-w s=H120>are only human</p-w>. <p-w s=H3605>Let them all</p-w> <p-w s=H6908>assemble</p-w> <p-w s=H5975>and take their stand</p-w>; <p-w s=H3162>they will all</p-w> <p-w s=H6342>be brought to terror</p-w> <p-w s=H954>and shame</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2796>The blacksmith</p-w> <p-w s=H4621>takes a tool</p-w> <p-w s=H6466>and labors</p-w> <p-w s=H6352>over the coals</p-w>; <p-w s=H3335>he fashions an idol</p-w> <p-w s=H4717>with hammers</p-w> <p-w s=H6466>and forges it</p-w> <p-w s=H3581>with his strong</p-w> <p-w s=H2220>arms</p-w>. <p-w s=H1571>Yet</p-w> <p-w s=H7456>he grows hungry</p-w> <p-w s=H3581>and loses his strength</p-w>; <p-w s=H3808>he fails</p-w> <p-w s=H8354>to drink</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>water</p-w> <p-w s=H3286>and grows faint</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2796>The woodworker</p-w> <p-w s=H5186>extends</p-w> <p-w s=H6957>a measuring line</p-w>; <p-w s=H8388>he marks it out</p-w> <p-w s=H8279>with a stylus</p-w>; <p-w s=H6213>he shapes</p-w> <p-w s=H4741>it with chisels</p-w> <p-w s=H8388>and outlines</p-w> <p-w s=H4230>it with a compass</p-w>. <p-w s=H6213>He fashions it</p-w> <p-w s=H8403>in the likeness</p-w> <p-w s=H376>of man</p-w>, <p-w s=H120>like man</p-w> <p-w s=H8597>in all his glory</p-w>, <p-w s=H3427>that it may dwell</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>in a shrine</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3772>He cuts down</p-w> <p-w s=H730>cedars</p-w> <p-w s=H3947>or retrieves</p-w> <p-w s=H8645>a cypress</p-w> <p-w s=H437>or oak</p-w>. <p-w s=H553>He lets it grow strong</p-w> <p-w s=H6086>among the trees</p-w> <p-w s=H3293>of the forest</p-w>. <p-w s=H5193>He plants</p-w> <p-w s=H766>a laurel</p-w>, <p-w s=H1653>and the rain</p-w> <p-w s=H1431>makes it grow</p-w>.

<p-w s=H1961>It serves</p-w> <p-w s=H1197>as fuel</p-w> <p-w s=H120>for man</p-w>. <p-w s=H3947>He takes</p-w> some of it <p-w s=H2552>to warm himself</p-w>, <p-w s=H637>and</p-w> <p-w s=H5400>he kindles a fire</p-w> <p-w s=H644>and bakes</p-w> <p-w s=H3899>his bread</p-w>. <p-w s=H637>He also</p-w> <p-w s=H6466>fashions it</p-w> <p-w s=H410>into a god</p-w> <p-w s=H7812>and worships it</p-w>; <p-w s=H6213>he makes</p-w> <p-w s=H6459>an idol</p-w> <p-w s=H5456>and bows down</p-w> to it.

<p-w s=H8313>He burns</p-w> <p-w s=H2677>half</p-w> <p-w s=H1119>of it in</p-w> <p-w s=H784>the fire</p-w>, <p-w s=H6740>and he roasts</p-w> <p-w s=H1320>meat</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H2677>that half</p-w>. <p-w s=H398>He eats</p-w> <p-w s=H6748>the roast</p-w> <p-w s=H7646>and is satisfied</p-w>. <p-w s=H637>Indeed</p-w>, <p-w s=H2552>he warms himself</p-w> <p-w s=H559>and says</p-w>, “<p-w s=H1889>Ah</p-w>! <p-w s=H2552>I am warm</p-w>; <p-w s=H7200>I see</p-w> <p-w s=H217>the fire</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H3808>They do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3045>comprehend</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>or</p-w> <p-w s=H995>discern</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H2902>He has shut</p-w> <p-w s=H5869>their eyes</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>so they cannot see</p-w> <p-w s=H3820>and closed their minds</p-w> <p-w s=H7919>so they cannot understand</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3808>And no one</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>considers</p-w> <p-w s=H413>in</p-w> <p-w s=H3820>his heart</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>no</p-w> <p-w s=H1847>one has the knowledge</p-w> <p-w s=H8394>or insight</p-w> <p-w s=H559>to say</p-w>, “<p-w s=H8313>I burned</p-w> <p-w s=H2677>half</p-w> <p-w s=H1119>of it in</p-w> <p-w s=H784>the fire</p-w>, <p-w s=H637>and I</p-w> <p-w s=H644>baked</p-w> <p-w s=H3899>bread</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H1513>its coals</p-w>; <p-w s=H6740>I roasted</p-w> <p-w s=H1320>meat</p-w> <p-w s=H398>and I ate</p-w>. <p-w s=H6213>Shall I make</p-w> <p-w s=H8441>something detestable</p-w> <p-w s=H3499>with the rest of it</p-w>? <p-w s=H5456>Shall I bow down</p-w> <p-w s=H944>to a block</p-w> <p-w s=H6086>of wood</p-w>?”

<p-w s=H7462>He feeds on</p-w> <p-w s=H665>ashes</p-w>. <p-w s=H2048>His deluded</p-w> <p-w s=H3820>heart</p-w> <p-w s=H5186>has led him astray</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>and he cannot</p-w> <p-w s=H5337>deliver</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>himself</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>or</p-w> <p-w s=H559>say</p-w>, “<p-w s=H3808>Is not</p-w> <p-w s=H3225>this thing in my right hand</p-w> <p-w s=H8267>a lie</p-w>?”

<p-w s=H7442>Sing for joy</p-w>, <p-w s=H8064>O heavens</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>has done this</p-w>; <p-w s=H7321>shout aloud</p-w>, <p-w s=H8482>O depths</p-w> <p-w s=H776>of the earth</p-w>. <p-w s=H6476>Break forth</p-w> <p-w s=H7440>in song</p-w>, <p-w s=H2022>O mountains</p-w>, <p-w s=H3293>you forests</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and all your</p-w> <p-w s=H6086>trees</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1350>has redeemed</p-w> <p-w s=H3290>Jacob</p-w>, <p-w s=H6286>and revealed His glory</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>in Israel</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3541>Thus</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H1350>your Redeemer</p-w> <p-w s=H3335>who formed you</p-w> <p-w s=H990>from the womb</p-w>: “<p-w s=H595>I</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>am the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H6213>who has made</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all things</p-w>, <p-w s=H5186>who alone stretched out</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>the heavens</p-w>, <p-w s=H4310>who by Myself</p-w> <p-w s=H7554>spread out</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w>,

<p-w s=H6565>who foils</p-w> <p-w s=H226>the signs</p-w> <p-w s=H907>of false prophets</p-w> <p-w s=H1984>and makes fools of</p-w> <p-w s=H7080>diviners</p-w>, <p-w s=H7725>who confounds</p-w> <p-w s=H2450>the wise</p-w> <p-w s=H1847>and turns their knowledge</p-w> <p-w s=H5528>into nonsense</p-w>,

<p-w s=H6965>who confirms</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>the message</p-w> <p-w s=H5650>of His servant</p-w> <p-w s=H7999>and fulfills</p-w> <p-w s=H6098>the counsel</p-w> <p-w s=H4397>of His messengers</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>who says</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>of Jerusalem</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H3427>She will be inhabited</p-w>,’ <p-w s=H5892>and of the cities</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H1129>They will be rebuilt</p-w>, <p-w s=H6965>and I will restore</p-w> <p-w s=H2723>their ruins</p-w>,’
<p-w s=H559>who says</p-w> <p-w s=H6683>to the depths of the sea</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H2717>Be dry</p-w>, <p-w s=H3001>and I will dry up</p-w> <p-w s=H5104>your currents</p-w>,’

<p-w s=H3541>This is what</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w> <p-w s=H3566>to Cyrus</p-w> <p-w s=H4899>His anointed</p-w>, <p-w s=H3225>whose right hand</p-w> <p-w s=H2388>I have grasped</p-w> <p-w s=H7286>to subdue</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>nations</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before him</p-w>, <p-w s=H6605>to disarm</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>kings</p-w>, <p-w s=H6605>to open</p-w> <p-w s=H1817>the doors</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before him</p-w>, <p-w s=H8179>so that the gates</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>will not</p-w> <p-w s=H5462>be shut</p-w>:

<p-w s=H4100>How</p-w> <p-w s=H4998>beautiful</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H2022>the mountains</p-w> <p-w s=H7272>are the feet</p-w> <p-w s=H1319>of those who bring good news</p-w>, <p-w s=H8085>who proclaim</p-w> <p-w s=H7965>peace</p-w>, <p-w s=H1319>who bring</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>good tidings</p-w>, <p-w s=H8085>who proclaim</p-w> <p-w s=H3444>salvation</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>who say</p-w> <p-w s=H6726>to Zion</p-w>, “<p-w s=H430>Your God</p-w> <p-w s=H4427>reigns</p-w>!”

<p-w s=H5493>Depart</p-w>, <p-w s=H5493>depart</p-w>, <p-w s=H3318>go out</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>from there</p-w>! <p-w s=H5060>Touch</p-w> <p-w s=H408>no</p-w> <p-w s=H2931>unclean thing</p-w>; <p-w s=H3318>come out</p-w> <p-w s=H8432>from it</p-w>, <p-w s=H1305>purify yourselves</p-w>, <p-w s=H5375>you who carry</p-w> <p-w s=H3627>the vessels</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w>.

<p-w s=H834>Just as</p-w> <p-w s=H7227>many</p-w> <p-w s=H8074>were appalled</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>at Him</p-w>— <p-w s=H4758>His appearance</p-w> <p-w s=H4893>was disfigured</p-w> <p-w s=H376>beyond that of any man</p-w>, <p-w s=H8389>and His form</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>was marred beyond human likeness</p-w>—

<p-w s=H4310>Who</p-w> <p-w s=H539>has believed</p-w> <p-w s=H8052>our message</p-w>? <p-w s=H5921>And to</p-w> <p-w s=H4310>whom</p-w> <p-w s=H2220>has the arm</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1540>been revealed</p-w>?

<p-w s=H5927>He grew up</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before Him</p-w> <p-w s=H3126>like a tender shoot</p-w>, <p-w s=H8328>and like a root</p-w> <p-w s=H6723>out of dry</p-w> <p-w s=H776>ground</p-w>. <p-w s=H3808>He had no</p-w> <p-w s=H8389>stately form</p-w> <p-w s=H1926>or majesty</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>to attract us</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>no</p-w> <p-w s=H4758>beauty</p-w> <p-w s=H2530>that we should desire Him</p-w>.

<p-w s=H959>He was despised</p-w> <p-w s=H2310>and rejected</p-w> <p-w s=H376>by men</p-w>, <p-w s=H376>a man</p-w> <p-w s=H4341>of sorrows</p-w>, <p-w s=H3045>acquainted</p-w> <p-w s=H2483>with grief</p-w>. <p-w s=H4564>Like one from whom men hide</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>their faces</p-w>, <p-w s=H959>He was despised</p-w>, <p-w s=H2803>and we esteemed Him</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>not</p-w>.

<p-w s=H403>Surely</p-w> <p-w s=H1931>He</p-w> <p-w s=H5375>took up</p-w> <p-w s=H2483>our infirmities</p-w> <p-w s=H5445>and carried</p-w> <p-w s=H4341>our sorrows</p-w>; <p-w s=H587>yet we</p-w> <p-w s=H2803>considered Him</p-w> <p-w s=H5060>stricken</p-w>, <p-w s=H5221>struck down</p-w> <p-w s=H430>by God</p-w>, <p-w s=H6031>and afflicted</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3605>We all</p-w> <p-w s=H6629>like sheep</p-w> <p-w s=H8582>have gone astray</p-w>, <p-w s=H376>each one</p-w> <p-w s=H6437>has turned</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>to his own way</p-w>; <p-w s=H3068>and the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6293>has laid</p-w> <p-w s=H853>upon Him</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>the iniquity</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>of us all</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3068>Yet it was the LORD’s</p-w> <p-w s=H2654>will</p-w> <p-w s=H1792>to crush Him</p-w> <p-w s=H2470>and to cause Him to suffer</p-w>; <p-w s=H518>and when</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>His soul</p-w> <p-w s=H7760>is made</p-w> <p-w s=H817>a guilt offering</p-w>, <p-w s=H7200>He will see</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>His offspring</p-w>, <p-w s=H748>He will prolong</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>His days</p-w>, <p-w s=H2656>and the good pleasure</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6743>will prosper</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>in His hand</p-w>.

“<p-w s=H6996>For a brief</p-w> <p-w s=H7281>moment</p-w> <p-w s=H5800>I forsook you</p-w>, <p-w s=H1419>but with great</p-w> <p-w s=H7356>compassion</p-w> <p-w s=H6908>I will bring you back</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3605>Every</p-w> <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> <p-w s=H1197>is senseless</p-w> <p-w s=H1847>and devoid of knowledge</p-w>; <p-w s=H3605>every</p-w> <p-w s=H6884>goldsmith</p-w> <p-w s=H3001>is put to shame</p-w> <p-w s=H6459>by his idols</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H5262>his molten images</p-w> <p-w s=H8267>are a fraud</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>and there is no</p-w> <p-w s=H7307>breath</p-w> in them.

¶ <p-w s=H622>Gather up</p-w> <p-w s=H3666>your belongings</p-w> <p-w s=H776>from this land</p-w>, <p-w s=H3427>you who live</p-w> <p-w s=H4692>under siege</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H1697>This is the word</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3414>Jeremiah</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>from the LORD</p-w>:

¶ <p-w s=H3068>And the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>told</p-w> <p-w s=H413>me</p-w>, “<p-w s=H4672>There is</p-w> <p-w s=H7195>a conspiracy</p-w> <p-w s=H376>among the men</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>and the residents</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>of Jerusalem</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H1961>And while Jeremiah had been</p-w> <p-w s=H6113>confined</p-w> <p-w s=H2691>in the courtyard</p-w> <p-w s=H4307>of the guard</p-w>, <p-w s=H1697>the word</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>had come</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3414>him</p-w>:

¶ <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>the son</p-w> <p-w s=H8227>of Shaphan</p-w>, <p-w s=H7650>swore an oath</p-w> to them <p-w s=H582>and their men</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>assuring them</p-w>, “<p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3372>be afraid</p-w> <p-w s=H5647>to serve</p-w> <p-w s=H3778>the Chaldeans</p-w>. <p-w s=H3427>Live</p-w> <p-w s=H776>in the land</p-w> <p-w s=H5647>and serve</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H894>of Babylon</p-w>, <p-w s=H3190>and it will go well</p-w> with you.

¶ <p-w s=H1571>When</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H3064>the Jews</p-w> <p-w s=H4124>in Moab</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>Ammon</p-w>, <p-w s=H123>Edom</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the other lands</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>heard</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H894>of Babylon</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>had left</p-w> <p-w s=H7611>a remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>in Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H6485>and had appointed</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>the son</p-w> <p-w s=H8227>of Shaphan</p-w>, <p-w s=H5921>over them</p-w>,

<p-w s=H3064>they</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>returned</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>from all</p-w> <p-w s=H4725>the places</p-w> <p-w s=H834>to which</p-w> <p-w s=H5080>they had been banished</p-w> <p-w s=H935>and came</p-w> <p-w s=H776>to the land</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w>, <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>at Mizpah</p-w>. <p-w s=H622>And they gathered</p-w> <p-w s=H7235>an abundance</p-w> <p-w s=H3196>of wine grapes</p-w> <p-w s=H7019>and summer fruit</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3110>Meanwhile, Johanan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H7143>of Kareah</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H8269>the commanders</p-w> <p-w s=H2428>of the armies</p-w> <p-w s=H7704>in the field</p-w> <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>at Mizpah</p-w>

<p-w s=H559>and said to him</p-w>, “<p-w s=H3045>Are you aware</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H1185>Baalis</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>of the Ammonites</p-w> <p-w s=H7971>has sent</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>to take</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>your life</p-w>?” <p-w s=H1436>But Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>did not</p-w> <p-w s=H539>believe</p-w> them.

¶ <p-w s=H3110>Then Johanan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H7143>of Kareah</p-w> <p-w s=H559>spoke</p-w> <p-w s=H5643>privately</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>at Mizpah</p-w>. “<p-w s=H1980>Let me go</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>and kill</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w>,” <p-w s=H559>he said</p-w>. “<p-w s=H3808>No</p-w> <p-w s=H376>one</p-w> <p-w s=H3045>will know it</p-w>. <p-w s=H4100>Why</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>should he take</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>your life</p-w> <p-w s=H6327>and scatter</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>the people of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H6908>who have gathered</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to you</p-w>, <p-w s=H7611>so that the remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w> <p-w s=H6>would perish</p-w>?”

¶ <p-w s=H1436>But Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3110>Johanan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H7143>of Kareah</p-w>, “<p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>do</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>such a thing</p-w>! <p-w s=H859>What you are</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>saying</p-w> <p-w s=H413>about</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H8267>is a lie</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H7637>In the seventh</p-w> <p-w s=H2320>month</p-w>, <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>the son</p-w> <p-w s=H476>of Elishama</p-w>, <p-w s=H4410>who was a member of the royal</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>family</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>and one of the king’s</p-w> <p-w s=H7227>chief officers</p-w>, <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with</p-w> <p-w s=H6235>ten</p-w> <p-w s=H582>men</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>at Mizpah</p-w>, <p-w s=H398>and they ate</p-w> <p-w s=H3899>a meal</p-w> <p-w s=H3162>together</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>there</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3458>Then Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H6235>and the ten</p-w> <p-w s=H582>men</p-w> <p-w s=H834>who</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>were</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with him</p-w> <p-w s=H6965>got up</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>and struck down</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>the son</p-w> <p-w s=H8227>of Shaphan</p-w>, <p-w s=H2719>with the sword</p-w>, <p-w s=H4191>killing</p-w> <p-w s=H853>the one</p-w> <p-w s=H834>whom</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>the king</p-w> <p-w s=H894>of Babylon</p-w> <p-w s=H6485>had appointed to govern</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H853>also</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>killed</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H3064>the Jews</p-w> <p-w s=H834>who</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>were</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>at Mizpah</p-w>, <p-w s=H3778>as well as the Chaldean</p-w> <p-w s=H4421>soldiers</p-w> <p-w s=H834>who</p-w> <p-w s=H8033>were there</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H8145>On the second</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>after the murder</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>of Gedaliah</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>when no</p-w> <p-w s=H376>one</p-w> <p-w s=H3045>yet knew about it</p-w>,

<p-w s=H8084>eighty</p-w> <p-w s=H582>men</p-w> <p-w s=H1548>who had shaved off</p-w> <p-w s=H2206>their beards</p-w>, <p-w s=H7167>torn</p-w> <p-w s=H899>their garments</p-w>, <p-w s=H1413>and cut themselves</p-w> <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> <p-w s=H7927>from Shechem</p-w>, <p-w s=H7887>Shiloh</p-w>, <p-w s=H8111>and Samaria</p-w>, <p-w s=H935>carrying</p-w> <p-w s=H4503>grain offerings</p-w> <p-w s=H3828>and frankincense</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>for the house</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3458>And Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H3318>went out</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>from</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>Mizpah</p-w> <p-w s=H7122>to meet them</p-w>, <p-w s=H1058>weeping</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>as he went</p-w>. <p-w s=H6298>When Ishmael encountered the men</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>he said</p-w>, “<p-w s=H935>Come</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H935>And when they came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>into</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>the city</p-w>, <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H582>and the men</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with him</p-w> <p-w s=H7819>slaughtered them</p-w> <p-w s=H413>and threw them into</p-w> <p-w s=H953>a cistern</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H6235>But ten</p-w> <p-w s=H582>of the men</p-w> among them <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w>, “<p-w s=H408>Do not</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>kill us</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H3426>we have</p-w> <p-w s=H4301>hidden treasure</p-w> <p-w s=H7704>in the field</p-w>— <p-w s=H2406>wheat</p-w>, <p-w s=H8184>barley</p-w>, <p-w s=H8081>oil</p-w>, <p-w s=H1706>and honey</p-w>!” <p-w s=H2308>So he refrained</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>from killing them</p-w> <p-w s=H8432>with</p-w> <p-w s=H251>the others</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H953>Now the cistern</p-w> <p-w s=H834>into which</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H7993>had thrown</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H6297>the bodies</p-w> <p-w s=H582>of the men</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>he had struck down</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>along with</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H834>was a large one that</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>King</p-w> <p-w s=H609>Asa</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>had made</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>for fear</p-w> <p-w s=H1201>of Baasha</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>. <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H4390>filled it</p-w> <p-w s=H2491>with the slain</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3458>Then Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H7617>took captive</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H7611>the remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>of the people</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>of Mizpah</p-w>— <p-w s=H1323>the daughters</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>of the king</p-w> <p-w s=H853>along with</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>the others</p-w> <p-w s=H7604>who remained</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>in Mizpah</p-w>— <p-w s=H834>over whom</p-w> <p-w s=H5018>Nebuzaradan</p-w> <p-w s=H7227>captain</p-w> <p-w s=H2876>of the guard</p-w> <p-w s=H6485>had appointed</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w>. <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H7617>took them captive</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>and set off</p-w> <p-w s=H5674>to cross over</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>the Ammonites</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3110>When Johanan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H7143>of Kareah</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H8269>the commanders</p-w> <p-w s=H2428>of the armies</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with</p-w> <p-w s=H853>him</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>heard</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>of all</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>the crimes</p-w> <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>had committed</p-w>,

<p-w s=H3947>they took</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H582>their men</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>and went</p-w> <p-w s=H3898>to fight</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w>. <p-w s=H4672>And they found</p-w> <p-w s=H853>him</p-w> <p-w s=H413>near</p-w> <p-w s=H7227>the great</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>pool</p-w> <p-w s=H1391>in Gibeon</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3605>When all</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>the people</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> <p-w s=H3110>Johanan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H7143>of Kareah</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H8269>the commanders</p-w> <p-w s=H2428>of the army</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with him</p-w>, <p-w s=H8055>they rejoiced</p-w>,

<p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>the people</p-w> <p-w s=H834>whom</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H7617>had taken captive</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>at</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>Mizpah</p-w> <p-w s=H5437>turned</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>and went over</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H3110>Johanan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H7143>of Kareah</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3458>But Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H8083>and eight</p-w> <p-w s=H582>of his men</p-w> <p-w s=H4422>escaped</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>from</p-w> <p-w s=H3110>Johanan</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>and went</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>the Ammonites</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3110>Then Johanan</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H7143>of Kareah</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H8269>the commanders</p-w> <p-w s=H2428>of the armies</p-w> <p-w s=H854>with him</p-w> <p-w s=H3947>took</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>the whole</p-w> <p-w s=H7611>remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H5971>of the people</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>from</p-w> <p-w s=H4709>Mizpah</p-w> <p-w s=H834>whom</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>he had recovered</p-w> <p-w s=H3458>from Ishmael</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H5418>of Nethaniah</p-w> <p-w s=H310>after</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>Ishmael had killed</p-w> <p-w s=H1436>Gedaliah</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H296>of Ahikam</p-w>: <p-w s=H1397>the soldiers</p-w>, <p-w s=H802>women</p-w>, <p-w s=H2945>children</p-w>, <p-w s=H5631>and court officials</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>he had brought back</p-w> <p-w s=H1391>from Gibeon</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6213>Pack</p-w> <p-w s=H3627>your bags</p-w> <p-w s=H1473>for exile</p-w>, <p-w s=H1323>O daughter</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>dwelling</p-w> <p-w s=H4714>in Egypt</p-w>! <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H5297>Memphis</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>will be</p-w> <p-w s=H8047>laid waste</p-w>, <p-w s=H5327>destroyed</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>and uninhabited</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6963>Egypt will hiss</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>like a fleeing</p-w> <p-w s=H5175>serpent</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>the enemy will advance</p-w> <p-w s=H2428>in force</p-w>; <p-w s=H7134>with axes</p-w> <p-w s=H935>they will come</p-w> against her <p-w s=H2404>like woodsmen cutting down trees</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H3068>The LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6635>of Hosts</p-w>, <p-w s=H430>the God</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: “<p-w s=H2005>Behold</p-w>, <p-w s=H6485>I am about to punish</p-w> <p-w s=H528>Amon</p-w> <p-w s=H4996>god of Thebes</p-w>, <p-w s=H6547>along with Pharaoh</p-w>, <p-w s=H4714>Egypt</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>with</p-w> <p-w s=H430>her gods</p-w> <p-w s=H4428>and kings</p-w>, <p-w s=H982>and those who trust</p-w> <p-w s=H6547>in Pharaoh</p-w>.

<p-w s=H859>But you</p-w>, <p-w s=H3290>O Jacob</p-w> <p-w s=H5650>My servant</p-w>, <p-w s=H408>do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3372>be afraid</p-w>, <p-w s=H408>and do not</p-w> <p-w s=H2865>be dismayed</p-w>, <p-w s=H3478>O Israel</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H3467>I will surely save you</p-w> <p-w s=H7350>out of a distant place</p-w>, <p-w s=H2233>your descendants</p-w> <p-w s=H776>from the land</p-w> <p-w s=H7628>of their captivity</p-w>! <p-w s=H3290>Jacob</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>will return</p-w> <p-w s=H8252>to quiet</p-w> <p-w s=H7599>and ease</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>with no one</p-w> <p-w s=H2729>to make him afraid</p-w>.

<p-w s=H859>And you</p-w>, <p-w s=H5650>My servant</p-w> <p-w s=H3290>Jacob</p-w>, <p-w s=H408>do not</p-w> <p-w s=H3372>be afraid</p-w>, <p-w s=H5002>declares</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H589>I</p-w> <p-w s=H854>am with you</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>Though</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>I will completely</p-w> <p-w s=H3617>destroy</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H1471>the nations</p-w> <p-w s=H834>to which</p-w> <p-w s=H5080>I have banished you</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>I will not</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>completely destroy you</p-w>. <p-w s=H3256>Yet I will discipline you</p-w> <p-w s=H4941>justly</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>and will by no means</p-w> <p-w s=H5352>leave you unpunished</p-w>.”

<p-w s=H3541>This is what</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: “<p-w s=H2009>See how</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>the waters</p-w> <p-w s=H5927>are rising</p-w> <p-w s=H6828>from the north</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>and becoming</p-w> <p-w s=H7857>an overflowing</p-w> <p-w s=H5158>torrent</p-w>. <p-w s=H7857>They will overflow</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w> <p-w s=H4393>and its fullness</p-w>, <p-w s=H5892>the cities</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>and their inhabitants</p-w>. <p-w s=H120>The people</p-w> <p-w s=H2199>will cry out</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>and all</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>who dwell</p-w> <p-w s=H776>in the land</p-w> <p-w s=H3213>will wail</p-w>

<p-w s=H5921>For</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>the day</p-w> <p-w s=H935>has come</p-w> <p-w s=H7703>to destroy</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H6430>the Philistines</p-w>, <p-w s=H3772>to cut off</p-w> <p-w s=H6865>from Tyre</p-w> <p-w s=H6721>and Sidon</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>every</p-w> <p-w s=H8300>remaining</p-w> <p-w s=H5826>ally</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>Indeed</p-w>, <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H7703>is about to destroy</p-w> <p-w s=H6430>the Philistines</p-w>, <p-w s=H7611>the remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H339>from the coasts</p-w> <p-w s=H3731>of Caphtor</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5804>The people of Gaza</p-w> <p-w s=H7144>will shave their heads in mourning</p-w>; <p-w s=H831>Ashkelon</p-w> <p-w s=H1820>will be silenced</p-w>. <p-w s=H7611>O remnant</p-w> <p-w s=H6010>of their valley</p-w>, <p-w s=H5704>how long</p-w> <p-w s=H1413>will you gash yourself</p-w>?

‘<p-w s=H5127>Flee</p-w>! <p-w s=H4422>Run</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>for your lives</p-w>! <p-w s=H1961>Become</p-w> <p-w s=H6176>like a juniper</p-w> <p-w s=H4057>in the desert</p-w>.’

¶ <p-w s=H123>Concerning Edom</p-w>, <p-w s=H3541>this is what</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6635>of Hosts</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: “<p-w s=H369>Is there no</p-w> <p-w s=H5750>longer</p-w> <p-w s=H2451>wisdom</p-w> <p-w s=H8487>in Teman</p-w>? <p-w s=H6098>Has counsel</p-w> <p-w s=H6>perished</p-w> <p-w s=H995>from the prudent</p-w>? <p-w s=H2451>Has their wisdom</p-w> <p-w s=H5628>decayed</p-w>?

<p-w s=H6963>At the sound</p-w> <p-w s=H5307>of their fall</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the earth</p-w> <p-w s=H7493>will quake</p-w>; <p-w s=H6818>their cry</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>will resound</p-w> <p-w s=H5488>to the Red</p-w> <p-w s=H3220>Sea</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3808>Is this nothing</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to you</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H5674>you who pass by</p-w>? <p-w s=H5027>Look around</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>and see</p-w>! <p-w s=H3426>Is there</p-w> <p-w s=H4341>any sorrow</p-w> <p-w s=H4341>like mine</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>which</p-w> <p-w s=H5953>was inflicted</p-w> on me, <p-w s=H834>which</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H3013>made me suffer</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>on the day</p-w> <p-w s=H2740>of His fierce</p-w> <p-w s=H639>anger</p-w>?

<p-w s=H7971>He sent</p-w> <p-w s=H784>fire</p-w> <p-w s=H4791>from on high</p-w>, <p-w s=H7287>and it overpowered</p-w> <p-w s=H6106>my bones</p-w>. <p-w s=H6566>He spread</p-w> <p-w s=H7568>a net</p-w> <p-w s=H7272>for my feet</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>and turned me</p-w> <p-w s=H268>back</p-w>. <p-w s=H5414>He made me</p-w> <p-w s=H8076>desolate</p-w>, <p-w s=H1739>faint</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>the day long</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6588>My transgressions</p-w> <p-w s=H8244>are bound into</p-w> <p-w s=H5923>a yoke</p-w>, <p-w s=H8276>knit together</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>by His hand</p-w>; <p-w s=H5927>they are draped</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>over</p-w> <p-w s=H6677>my neck</p-w>, <p-w s=H136>and the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3782>has broken</p-w> <p-w s=H3581>my strength</p-w>. <p-w s=H5414>He has delivered me</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>into the hands</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>of those I cannot</p-w> <p-w s=H6965>withstand</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5921>For</p-w> <p-w s=H428>these things</p-w> <p-w s=H589>I</p-w> <p-w s=H1058>weep</p-w>; <p-w s=H5869>my eyes</p-w> <p-w s=H3381>flow</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>with tears</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H7368>there is no one nearby</p-w> <p-w s=H5162>to comfort me</p-w>, <p-w s=H7725>no one to revive</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>my soul</p-w>. <p-w s=H1121>My children</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>are</p-w> <p-w s=H8074>destitute</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>because</p-w> <p-w s=H341>the enemy</p-w> <p-w s=H1396>has prevailed</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6726>Zion</p-w> <p-w s=H6566>stretches out</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>her hands</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>but there is no</p-w> <p-w s=H5162>one to comfort</p-w> her. <p-w s=H3068>The LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6680>has decreed</p-w> <p-w s=H3290>against Jacob</p-w> <p-w s=H5439>that his neighbors</p-w> <p-w s=H6862>become his foes</p-w>. <p-w s=H3389>Jerusalem</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>has become</p-w> <p-w s=H5079>an unclean thing</p-w> <p-w s=H996>among them</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3068>The LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6662>is righteous</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>yet</p-w> <p-w s=H4784>I rebelled</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>against His command</p-w>. <p-w s=H8085>Listen</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>all you people</p-w>; <p-w s=H7200>look upon</p-w> <p-w s=H4341>my suffering</p-w>. <p-w s=H970>My young men</p-w> <p-w s=H1330>and maidens</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>have gone</p-w> <p-w s=H7628>into captivity</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7121>I called out</p-w> <p-w s=H157>to my lovers</p-w>, <p-w s=H1992>but they</p-w> <p-w s=H7411>have betrayed me</p-w>. <p-w s=H3548>My priests</p-w> <p-w s=H2205>and elders</p-w> <p-w s=H1478>perished</p-w> <p-w s=H5892>in the city</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>while</p-w> <p-w s=H1245>they searched for</p-w> <p-w s=H400>food</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>to keep themselves</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>alive</p-w>.

<p-w s=H7200>See</p-w>, <p-w s=H3068>O LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>how</p-w> <p-w s=H6862>distressed</p-w> I am! <p-w s=H2560>I am churning</p-w> <p-w s=H4578>within</p-w>; <p-w s=H3820>my heart</p-w> <p-w s=H2015>is pounding</p-w> <p-w s=H7130>within me</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>for</p-w> <p-w s=H4784>I have been most rebellious</p-w>. <p-w s=H2351>Outside</p-w>, <p-w s=H2719>the sword</p-w> <p-w s=H7921>bereaves</p-w>; <p-w s=H1004>inside</p-w>, <p-w s=H4194>there is death</p-w>.

<p-w s=H8085>People have heard</p-w> <p-w s=H589>my</p-w> <p-w s=H584>groaning</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>but there is no</p-w> <p-w s=H5162>one to comfort</p-w> me. <p-w s=H3605>All</p-w> <p-w s=H341>my enemies</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>have heard</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>of my trouble</p-w>; <p-w s=H7797>they are glad</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H859>You</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>have caused it</p-w>. <p-w s=H935>May You bring</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>the day</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>You have announced</p-w>, <p-w s=H1961>so that they may become</p-w> <p-w s=H3644>like me</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3605>Let all</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>their wickedness</p-w> <p-w s=H935>come</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before You</p-w>, <p-w s=H5953>and deal</p-w> with them <p-w s=H834>as</p-w> <p-w s=H5953>You have dealt</p-w> with me <p-w s=H5921>because of</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H6588>my transgressions</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>For</p-w> <p-w s=H585>my groans</p-w> <p-w s=H7227>are many</p-w>, <p-w s=H3820>and my heart</p-w> <p-w s=H1742>is faint</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3808>Without</p-w> <p-w s=H2550>pity</p-w> <p-w s=H136>the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H1104>has swallowed up</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H5116>the dwellings</p-w> <p-w s=H3290>of Jacob</p-w>. <p-w s=H5678>In His wrath</p-w> <p-w s=H2040>He has demolished</p-w> <p-w s=H4013>the fortified cities</p-w> <p-w s=H1323>of the Daughter</p-w> <p-w s=H3063>of Judah</p-w>. <p-w s=H5060>He brought</p-w> <p-w s=H776>to the ground</p-w> <p-w s=H2490>and defiled</p-w> <p-w s=H4467>her kingdom</p-w> <p-w s=H8269>and its princes</p-w>.

<p-w s=H4100>What</p-w> <p-w s=H5749>can I say for you</p-w>? To <p-w s=H4100>what</p-w> <p-w s=H1819>can I compare you</p-w>, <p-w s=H1323>O Daughter</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>of Jerusalem</p-w>? ¶ <p-w s=H1697>Again the word</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to me</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>,

<p-w s=H3588>But if</p-w> <p-w s=H859>you</p-w> <p-w s=H2094>warn</p-w> <p-w s=H7563>the wicked man</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>to turn</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>from his way</p-w>, <p-w s=H3808>and he does not</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>turn</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>from it</p-w>, <p-w s=H1931>he</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>will die</p-w> <p-w s=H5771>in his iniquity</p-w>, <p-w s=H859>but you</p-w> <p-w s=H5337>will have saved</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>your life</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H859>Now as for you</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H120>of man</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>tell</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>the house</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H3651>that this is what</p-w> <p-w s=H559>they have said</p-w>: ‘<p-w s=H6588>Our transgressions</p-w> <p-w s=H2403>and our sins</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>are heavy</p-w> upon us, <p-w s=H587>and we</p-w> <p-w s=H4743>are wasting away because of them</p-w>! <p-w s=H349>How</p-w> <p-w s=H2421>can we live</p-w>?’

¶ <p-w s=H859>Therefore</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H120>of man</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>say</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1121>your people</p-w>: ‘<p-w s=H6666>The righteousness</p-w> <p-w s=H6662>of the righteous man</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>will not</p-w> <p-w s=H5337>deliver him</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>in the day</p-w> <p-w s=H6588>of his transgression</p-w>; <p-w s=H3808>neither</p-w> <p-w s=H7564>will the wickedness</p-w> <p-w s=H7563>of the wicked man</p-w> <p-w s=H3782>cause him to stumble</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>on the day</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>he turns</p-w> <p-w s=H7562>from his wickedness</p-w>. <p-w s=H3808>Nor will</p-w> <p-w s=H6662>the righteous man</p-w> <p-w s=H3201>be able</p-w> <p-w s=H2421>to survive</p-w> by his righteousness <p-w s=H3117>on the day</p-w> <p-w s=H2398>he sins</p-w>.’

¶ <p-w s=H559>If I tell</p-w> <p-w s=H6662>the righteous man</p-w> <p-w s=H2421>that he will surely live</p-w>, <p-w s=H1931>but he then</p-w> <p-w s=H982>trusts</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>in</p-w> <p-w s=H6666>his righteousness</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>and commits</p-w> <p-w s=H5766>iniquity</p-w>, <p-w s=H3605>then none</p-w> <p-w s=H6666>of his righteous works</p-w> <p-w s=H2142>will be remembered</p-w>; <p-w s=H4191>he will die</p-w> <p-w s=H5766>because of the iniquity</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>he has committed</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H559>But if I tell</p-w> <p-w s=H7563>the wicked man</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H4191>You will surely die</p-w>,’ <p-w s=H7725>and he turns</p-w> <p-w s=H2403>from his sin</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>and does</p-w> <p-w s=H4941>what is just</p-w> <p-w s=H6666>and right</p-w>—

<p-w s=H3605>None</p-w> <p-w s=H2403>of the sins</p-w> <p-w s=H2398>he has committed</p-w> <p-w s=H2142>will be held</p-w> against him. <p-w s=H6213>He has done</p-w> <p-w s=H4941>what is just</p-w> <p-w s=H6666>and right</p-w>; <p-w s=H2421>he will surely live</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H1121>Yet your people</p-w> <p-w s=H559>say</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H1870>The way</p-w> <p-w s=H136>of the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>is not</p-w> <p-w s=H8505>just</p-w>.’ <p-w s=H1992>But it is</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>their way</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>that is not</p-w> <p-w s=H8505>just</p-w>.

<p-w s=H6662>If a righteous man</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>turns</p-w> <p-w s=H6666>from his righteousness</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>and commits</p-w> <p-w s=H5766>iniquity</p-w>, <p-w s=H4191>he will die</p-w> for it.

<p-w s=H7563>But if a wicked man</p-w> <p-w s=H7725>turns</p-w> <p-w s=H7564>from his wickedness</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>and does</p-w> <p-w s=H4941>what is just</p-w> <p-w s=H6666>and right</p-w>, <p-w s=H1931>he</p-w> <p-w s=H2421>will live</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>because of this</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H559>Yet you say</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H1870>The way</p-w> <p-w s=H136>of the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>is not</p-w> <p-w s=H8505>just</p-w>.’ <p-w s=H8199>But I will judge</p-w> <p-w s=H376>each</p-w> <p-w s=H853>of you</p-w> <p-w s=H1870>according to his ways</p-w>, <p-w s=H1004>O house</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>.”

¶ <p-w s=H8147>In the twelfth</p-w> <p-w s=H8141>year</p-w> <p-w s=H1546>of our exile</p-w>, <p-w s=H2568>on the fifth day</p-w> <p-w s=H6224>of the tenth month</p-w>, <p-w s=H6412>a fugitive</p-w> <p-w s=H3389>from Jerusalem</p-w> <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to me</p-w> <p-w s=H559>and reported</p-w>, “<p-w s=H5892>The city</p-w> <p-w s=H5221>has been taken</p-w>!”

¶ <p-w s=H6153>Now the evening</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> <p-w s=H6412>the fugitive</p-w> <p-w s=H935>arrived</p-w>, <p-w s=H3027>the hand</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>was</p-w> <p-w s=H413>upon me</p-w>, <p-w s=H6605>and He opened</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>my mouth</p-w> <p-w s=H5704>before</p-w> <p-w s=H935>the man came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to me</p-w> <p-w s=H1242>in the morning</p-w>. <p-w s=H6310>So my mouth</p-w> <p-w s=H6605>was opened</p-w> <p-w s=H3808>and I was no</p-w> <p-w s=H5750>longer</p-w> <p-w s=H481>mute</p-w>.
¶ <p-w s=H1697>Then the word</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to me</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>,

“<p-w s=H1121>Son</p-w> <p-w s=H120>of man</p-w>, <p-w s=H3427>those living</p-w> <p-w s=H428>in the</p-w> <p-w s=H2723>ruins</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>in</p-w> <p-w s=H127>the land</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H559>are saying</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H85>Abraham</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>was</p-w> <p-w s=H259>only one man</p-w>, <p-w s=H3423>yet he possessed</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w>. <p-w s=H587>But we</p-w> <p-w s=H7227>are many</p-w>; <p-w s=H776>surely the land</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>has been given</p-w> to us <p-w s=H4181>as a possession</p-w>.’

¶ <p-w s=H3651>Therefore</p-w> <p-w s=H559>tell</p-w> <p-w s=H413>them</p-w> <p-w s=H3541>that this is what</p-w> <p-w s=H136>the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3069>GOD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: ‘<p-w s=H398>You eat</p-w> <p-w s=H1818>meat with the blood in it</p-w>, <p-w s=H5375>lift up</p-w> <p-w s=H5869>your eyes</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to</p-w> <p-w s=H1544>your idols</p-w>, <p-w s=H8210>and shed</p-w> <p-w s=H1818>blood</p-w>. <p-w s=H3423>Should you then possess</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w>?

<p-w s=H5975>You have relied</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>on</p-w> <p-w s=H2719>your swords</p-w>, <p-w s=H6213>you have committed</p-w> <p-w s=H8441>detestable acts</p-w>, <p-w s=H376>and each</p-w> <p-w s=H2930>of you has defiled</p-w> <p-w s=H7453>his neighbor’s</p-w> <p-w s=H802>wife</p-w>. <p-w s=H3423>Should you then possess</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w>?’

¶ <p-w s=H559>Tell</p-w> <p-w s=H413>them</p-w> <p-w s=H3541>that this</p-w> <p-w s=H3541>is what</p-w> <p-w s=H136>the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3069>GOD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: ‘<p-w s=H589>As surely as I</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>live</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>those</p-w> <p-w s=H2723>in the ruins</p-w> <p-w s=H5307>will fall</p-w> <p-w s=H2719>by the sword</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>those</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>in</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>the open field</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>I will give</p-w> <p-w s=H398>to be devoured</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>by wild animals</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>and those</p-w> <p-w s=H4679>in the strongholds</p-w> <p-w s=H4631>and caves</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>will die</p-w> <p-w s=H1698>by plague</p-w>.

<p-w s=H5414>I will make</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w> <p-w s=H8077>a desolate</p-w> <p-w s=H4923>waste</p-w>, <p-w s=H1347>and the pride</p-w> <p-w s=H5797>of her strength</p-w> <p-w s=H7673>will come to an end</p-w>. <p-w s=H2022>The mountains</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w> <p-w s=H8074>will become desolate</p-w>, <p-w s=H369>so that no one</p-w> <p-w s=H5674>will pass through</p-w>.

<p-w s=H3045>Then they will know</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H589>I</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>am the LORD</p-w>, <p-w s=H5414>when I have made</p-w> <p-w s=H776>the land</p-w> <p-w s=H8077>a desolate</p-w> <p-w s=H4923>waste</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>because of</p-w> <p-w s=H3605>all</p-w> <p-w s=H8441>the abominations</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>they have committed</p-w>.’

¶ <p-w s=H859>As for you</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> <p-w s=H120>of man</p-w>, <p-w s=H1121>your people</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>are talking</p-w> about you <p-w s=H681>near</p-w> <p-w s=H7023>the city walls</p-w> <p-w s=H6607>and in the doorways</p-w> <p-w s=H1004>of their houses</p-w>. <p-w s=H2297>One</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>speaks</p-w> <p-w s=H854>to</p-w> <p-w s=H259>another</p-w>, <p-w s=H376>each</p-w> <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w> <p-w s=H251>to his brother</p-w>, ‘<p-w s=H935>Come</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>and hear</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>the message</p-w> <p-w s=H3318>that has come</p-w> <p-w s=H854>from</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>the LORD</p-w>!’

¶ <p-w s=H5971>So My people</p-w> <p-w s=H935>come</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to you</p-w> <p-w s=H3996>as usual</p-w>, <p-w s=H3427>sit</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before you</p-w>, <p-w s=H8085>and hear</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>your words</p-w>; <p-w s=H3808>but they do not</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>put them into practice</p-w>. <p-w s=H3588>Although</p-w> <p-w s=H1992>they</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>express</p-w> <p-w s=H5690>love</p-w> <p-w s=H6310>with their mouths</p-w>, <p-w s=H3820>their hearts</p-w> <p-w s=H1980>pursue</p-w> <p-w s=H1215>dishonest gain</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2005>Indeed, you are</p-w> to them <p-w s=H5690>like a singer of love</p-w> <p-w s=H7892>songs</p-w> <p-w s=H3303>with a beautiful</p-w> <p-w s=H6963>voice</p-w>, <p-w s=H3190>who skillfully</p-w> <p-w s=H5059>plays an instrument</p-w>. <p-w s=H8085>They hear</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>your words</p-w> <p-w s=H369>but do not</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>put them into practice</p-w>.

<p-w s=H935>So when it comes to pass</p-w>— <p-w s=H2009>and surely</p-w> <p-w s=H935>it will come</p-w>— <p-w s=H3045>then they will know</p-w> <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> <p-w s=H5030>a prophet</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>has been</p-w> <p-w s=H8432>among them</p-w>.”
¶ <p-w s=H1697>Then the word</p-w> <p-w s=H3068>of the LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1961>came</p-w> <p-w s=H413>to me</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>,

“<p-w s=H1121>Son</p-w> <p-w s=H120>of man</p-w>, <p-w s=H5012>prophesy</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>against</p-w> <p-w s=H7462>the shepherds</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>. <p-w s=H5012>Prophesy</p-w> <p-w s=H559>and tell</p-w> <p-w s=H7462>them</p-w> <p-w s=H3541>that this is what</p-w> <p-w s=H136>the Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3069>GOD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>says</p-w>: ‘<p-w s=H1945>Woe</p-w> <p-w s=H7462>to the shepherds</p-w> <p-w s=H3478>of Israel</p-w>, <p-w s=H834>who</p-w> <p-w s=H7462>only feed</p-w> <p-w s=H853>themselves</p-w>! <p-w s=H3808>Should not</p-w> <p-w s=H7462>the shepherds</p-w> <p-w s=H7462>feed</p-w> <p-w s=H6629>their flock</p-w>?
